[h1]New Feature: TruRACS (True Random Antler Configuration System)[/h1]
TruRACS randomly generates animal trophies like antlers to drastically increase the variation that you can find in the game. No trophy will look like the other any more with more than 1 million variations per species. This update introduces TruRacs for Whitetail and Blacktail deer. More animals will be added over time.

[h1]New Feature: TruSCORE[/h1]
The Harvest Screen now features information about your trophy and explains the scoring. All factors are explained for you to understand the calculation behind every trophy so you can scout for these factors when spotting new animals.

[h1]Added Gramophone to the Trophy Lodge[/h1]
Locate the Gramophone in the Trophy Lodge and interact with it to cycle through different music that you can enjoy while spending time in the Trophy Lodge

[h1]Change Log:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when selecting “Trophy Lodge” in the side menu when in offline mode on PC
[*] Fixed issue of common female mallard ducks appearing as males when placed as trophies
[*] Fixed issue that sometimes resulted in buying wrong item at the cache
[*] Fixed issue that allowed to interact with inactive UI layers (which often presented itself by clicking Quit to Desktop in the main menu when actually clicking Back in a submenu)
[*] Improved network position interpolation for a better experience for players with older hardware or a bad internet connection. Animals will now move smoother from one place to the next and jitter less
[*] Fixed issue of not being able to join a multiplayer game even if there was a last open slot remaining
[*] Fixed issue of character standing while inside a layout blind
[*] Fixed animation issue of Bison twisting its head unnaturally when hit
[*] Fixed animation issue of recoil of shotguns going outwards
[*] Fixed issue that caused player footsteps to be muted when holding Huntermate or certain items
[*] Improved audio mix in the Trophy Lodge to better hear the birds in the trees
[*] Updated the numbers for Rooms, Platforms and Plaques in the Spring Creek Manor Trophy Lodge
[*] In Progress: Issues with mismatch of Geese groups between Host and Client.
This issue currently leads to problems in multiplayer where the host player can see Geese that other clients are not able to see. We are working on resolving this issue but it will unfortunately take more time. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.33
notes.notes:
Here are the notes for today's Patch!

[b]New Feature: Trophy Lodge - Spring Creek Manor[/b]

Showcase your best animals in your very own Trophy Lodge. Plaques and full body mounts of different sizes allow you to present your harvests in a variety of different poses. Invite your friends to your Trophy Lodge or travel to theirs in Single and Multiplayer.
When in a reserve, open the Pause Menu, navigate to the new “Trophy Lodge” Button in the left navigation strip. Create a new Trophy Lodge from the available Lodges - Spring Creek Manor being the first available lodge. Select the newly created Trophy Lodge and “Go to Lodge” in order to travel there.
Once in your lodge, you can switch between “Edit” and “View” mode and can follow the on-screen controls.

Please note that creating a Trophy Lodge requires ownership of the Trophy Lodge DLC.
You can travel to other player’s lodges without owning the DLC.
Once a Trophy Lodge is created but the ownership is revoked, you can still travel to your created lodge but access to the Edit mode is denied until ownership is restored.


[b]New Feature: Trophy Manager[/b]

When harvesting an animal, you are now able to taxidermize or save it for later. Taxidermy comes with a cost but you can save the animal for later taxidermy.
When in the Trophy Lodge, you can access your Trophy Manager to taxidermize saved animals, retrieve already put up animals or simply browse your collection.

Trophy Manager, Taxidermy or saving animals does not require any additional ownership and is granted with access to the base game.


List of Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue of Roosevelt Elk changing size when idle or walking
[*] Holding Breath no longer toggles sprinting
[*] Fixed issue of Red Deer mating call not being audible
[*] Fixed issue of European Bison not creating HUD element nor audio when calling
[*] Fixed issue of not being able to hit Blue Wildebeest’s brain
[*] Fixed issue of the wounded deer not spawning correctly during Fleischer - Returning the Favor mission 
[*] Fixed issue of antlers & horns becoming offset if the animal was harvested in a multiplayer game by a non-shooter
[*] Fixed issue of Gemsbok overextending neck when reaching to the side while eating
[*] Fixed issue of Snort Wheeze caller listed as compatible for Mule Deer
[*] Fixed issue of several animals’ fur variation missing in the Harvest Screen
[*] Fixed issues with binoculars in 3rd person animations
[*] Fixed visual issue when going from stand to prone with Cacciatore 12G while aiming down sights
[*] Bolt-action rechambering animation no longer plays when firing SA shotguns with Muscle Memory 1
[*] Fixed issue of shooting Red Deer in the skull hurting its foot
[*] Reintroduced animation for changing zeroing leaf on KING 470DB
[*] Unlocking Zeroing no longer requires both Breath Control and Steady Hands but only one of them
[*] Fixed animation issue with Cacciatore 12G when chambering next shell after aiming down sights
[*] STRECKER 20GA no longer plays leaf animation when changing the zeroing
[*] Fixed issue with being able to endlessly chamber bullets on the Cacciatore 12G while aiming with Manual Chambering being switched on
[*] Fixed visual issues when using Deer Grunt Caller
[/list]

notes.title: The Joy Of laying down your arms in theHunter: Call of the Wild
notes.notes:
I ve never been a big fan of hunting, which is why I didn t think I d be so captivated by theHunter: Call of the Wild. But I don t love it for the hunting. I discovered that, once you lay down your arms and forget about bringing home the venison, this hunting simulator becomes an amazingly relaxing experience. If you subvert its purpose almost entirely, it s actually just a lovely walking simulator.

Avuxeni Hunters!
We are excited to announce that today marks the release of our latest addition to Vurhonga Savanna, the Lion! 

The efforts you've made under Grandfather Njabulo's guidance have borne fruit once again after the gemsbok, as Vurhonga now gets its lions back. In addition to being Vurhonga's first carnivore, it is also Call of the Wild's first ever Apex Predator. They're nomadic, prideless African lions that have been introduced into the savanna to mark their territory and give players a new challenge in the open plains of central Vurhonga. The lions of Vurhonga, much like real lions, are curious animals. They haven't been exposed to humans and don't see them as prey but as invaders. Occasionally, when a lion senses you as a threat to its life or territory, it will approach and confront you. During a confrontation, its objective is to either scare you off or kill you and your actions will determine the odds of your survival... 

This update also contains a long list of bug fixes as well as a[b] rework of spinal cords.[/b]
Given that some animals (like buffalo and bison) have very large vertebrae (spinal cord), spine shots were the easiest way to down them. With this update, the spinal cord is separated out as an own “organ” to come closer to a realistic and ethical hunting experience. Vertebrae shots are higher damage shots than other bones, but they are no longer instant kills. Also, to make vital organs more viable, such as double lung shots, we have increased the time threshold for Quick Kill Bonus from 5 to 8 seconds.

You can read more about the Lion on our Steam Store page, or find the full Lion update content summary and the patch notes below:

notes.title: Trailblazer Beta now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/610bdb97759b7e52ba512be97dd4cfc13538bcf6.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

As you may have noticed from our clues on social media the past week, Grandfather Njabulo has decided that it is time to reintroduce the largest native carnivore and King of the Beasts - the Lion! This majestic creature is not only the second-largest of the cats, but is also an apex predator that does not take kindly to trespassers on its territory. On top of this free addition to Vurhonga Savanna, we will also be releasing a bunch of general improvements to the game.

To continue our "Trailblazer Programme" from last year, we are offering a new Open Beta for the Lion and encourage those of you who want to participate to share your thoughts and feedback on our latest animal addition.

[h1]The Trailblazer Beta, what does it entail?[/h1]
It’s a chance for you to, during a limited period, experience changes to the game before they are technically “live”. It’s also a way for us to test updates without “committing” them to the main version of the game.

[h1]How long does the Trailblazer Beta run for? [/h1]
The Beta will be available from around about now i.e.[b] Friday January 25th (as of this post going live), until Monday January 28th [/b]

[h1]How can I get involved?[/h1]
Right-click theHunter: Call of the Wild in your Steam library and click “Properties”. A window will prompt and you click the tab at the far right labeled “Betas”, you will then come to a window that looks like the below:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/4b6391d0e32d9b4d34a435c02bd34afb0782054a.jpg[/img]
Please enter the following code in the box (without the quotation marks): [b]“CalloftheWild”[/b], then CLICK “Check Code” (just hitting enter won’t work). You should now notice that your game will start an update, this will be the Open Beta build installing.

Note: The download can potentially be large, and this will need to be re-downloaded as you switch between the live/Open Beta clients, so those on metered internet connections please bear that in mind.

[h1]So what happens to my old build and save files?[/h1]
Nothing. When you start the Open beta client your game will be entirely “fresh”, you’ll have no save game, cash, skills etc. But don’t worry, this has NO effect on your “live” version of the game, you can switch back and forth at any time (see the next point below). 

Note: We DO have a means for you to get up and running quickly in the Trailblazer Beta. Hit “Escape” and go to the Hunt Club Beta menu, there’ll be a reward there where you can claim a large sum of credits, a big XP boost and weapon score points in all categories. 

[h1]I’ve had enough of testing the Open Beta for now, how do I go back to my normal version of the game?[/h1]
Do the initial same steps as when installing the Open Beta, but when you get to the Beta tab you should not fill in a code. Instead in the drop-down box saying “Select the beta you would like to opt into:” you simply pick “None - opt out of all beta programs” and your client will run a small update. After that, you can play the normal version of the game again. You can switch back and forth between the live version and Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme at any time during the period just by using that dropdown menu.


[h1]How do provide feedback or I report issues I’ve found during the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme?[/h1]
Please use our “Beta Feedback” board on the Steam Community Hub here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/

[h1]What do you want us to test?[/h1]
Yay, you’ve made it to the best part! Please see below the changelog for the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme, this will give you some ideas about what to look at specifically when playing on it.

Note: You WILL need ownership to the relevant content on the live version of the game in order to test it in the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme. For example, new Vurhonga Savanna-specific content would require you owning that particular DLC. That being said, you can of course join a multiplayer hosted game on that reserve should you not own it yourself.

[h1]
[b]Changelog[/b][/h1]

[*] [b]The new animal on Vurhonga Savannah - the Lion. [/b]

The efforts you've made under Grandfather Njabulo's guidance have borne fruit once again after the gemsbok, as Vurhonga now gets its lions back. In addition to being Vurhonga's first carnivore. They're nomadic, prideless African lions that have been introduced into the savanna to mark their territory and give players a new challenge in the open plains of central Vurhonga. The lions of Vurhonga, much like real lions, are curious animals. They haven't been exposed to humans and don't see them as prey, but as invaders. Occasionally, when a lion senses you as a threat to its life or territory, it will approach and confront you. During a confrontation, its objective is to either scare you off or kill you and your actions will determine the chance of your survival. Look to the codex for hints on how to survive.

[*] [b] The Rework of the Spinal Cord [/b]: in previous releases, the vertebrae and spinal cord were consolidated into single "organs". Given that some animals (like buffalo and bison) have very large vertebrae, spine shots were the easiest way to down them. With this build, the vertebrae are separated out. Vertebrae shots are higher damage shots than other bones, but they no longer are instant kills. Also, to make double lung shots more viable, we’d increased the threshold time for max scoring Quick Kill by 60%.

[*] General bug fixes to older content such as UI, animal behaviour, achievements, mission releated bug fixes 

[b]Please note that we have a long list of additional improvements in the upcoming release.[/b]

 Again, please be sure to put any feedback or bug reports you may encounter (ONLY from this beta version of the game) on the new forum here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/

And please see this bug reporting template that provides some guidelines of what kind of information that might be helpful to us, so we can easier read through your feedback: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/1735469327937280314/

Enjoy and thank you for your feedback!

/theHunter: Call of the Wild team

notes.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild - Parque Fernando Release Update
notes.notes:
Hey Hunters,

Thank you very much for all your early feedback and reports about our new reserve Parque Fernando!

We’ve been sifting through your comments both in the forum and on our social channels and our highest priority at the moment is to fix the issues with [b]game crashes related to AMD graphics cards[/b]. We will keep you continuously updated on our progress! 

We will also take another look at the Mule Deer to see if we can alter its appearance and make it slightly bigger. This is just a start and more feature improvements will happen - we will address them as soon as the more urgent matters (see above) are resolved.

While we continue the work on our next patch, here are a couple of work-around tips to help in case you experience any of these issues:

[h1]
[b]Stuck on the mission “The Gold Mine” [/b][/h1]
Make sure to retreat back to the position the game tells you to, after you’ve placed the dynamite. If you missed that step, and the mission objective does not progress, try going back to the original position where you placed the dynamite and place it again but this time shoot it from the position that the game communicates. Hope this helps and thank you to Zachious for providing us with the solution! 
[h1][b]Need zones discovered by guests don’t save for the host[/b][/h1]
When you host a multiplayer game and guest players discover a need zone, this is currently not saved in your own single player game. The host (i.e. you) has to discover another need zone in order for the guest found need zones to be saved.

Keep the great feedback coming! The more detailed you can be when you write us reports, the easier we can figure out how to solve your issues as we want you to experience the beauty and thrill of Parque Fernando without hitting any snags. 

All the best,

Your theHunter: Call of the Wild team

notes.title: Introducing the Gemsbok, and Trailblazer Beta
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/fc5a5a51f893d48a08a2c353acaf2bd4d7c9b5f7.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Some of you may have seen the new species clues that we’ve released on social media over the previous couple of days, it's soon time to meet the Gemsbok! The gemsbok is a large antelope of the "Oryx" genus that's typically found in Southern Africa/the Kalahari desert, you however will be meeting it in Vurhonga Savanna (at no extra cost)! This new species will in fact be coming along together with some large general improvements to theHunter: Call of the Wild. As such we are taking extra steps to ensure this can be the best release possible. 

For the first time ever we’ll offer you an Open Beta period that we’re lovingly calling the “Trailblazer Programme”. We’ve received a lot of feedback in the past where players have requested the chance to take part in early testing of new content and this particular update is the perfect time for us to try it out and get you all involved early.

[h1]The Trailblazer Programme sounds cool, but what does it entail?[/h1]
It’s a chance for you to, during a limited period, play new content before it is technically “live”. It’s also a way for us to get advance notice of bugs that may otherwise not be visible during internal testing (thousands of players are always going to find things that even the most dedicated of QA teams might miss).

[h1]How long does the Trailblazer Programme run for?[/h1]
The program will be available from around about now (as of this post going live), until Monday 5th November, 12pm CET.

[h1]Who can take part in the Trailblazer Programme?[/h1]
At the moment it is only available for PC players due to how quickly we can deploy things on the PC platform (nothing personal against our console fans, we appreciate you just as much!). The good news is that all of the benefits gained from running the Trailblazer Programme will transfer over into our console builds of the game, which is a win for everybody!

[h1]
How can I get involved?[/h1]
Right-click theHunter: Call of the Wild in your Steam library and click “Properties”. A window will prompt and you click the tab at the far right labelled “Betas”, you will then come to a window that looks like the below:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/e428dfc6c4101373aed943250acd6d11fa31bdf7.jpg[/img]

Please enter the following code in the box (without the quotation marks): “CalloftheWild”, then CLICK “Check Code” (just hitting enter won’t work). You should now notice that your game will start an update, this will be the Open Beta build installing.

Note: The download is approximately 30GB in size, and this will need to be re-downloaded as you switch between the live/Open Beta clients, so those on metered internet connections please bear that in mind.

[h1]So what happens to my old build and save files?[/h1]
Nothing. When you start the Open beta client your game will be entirely “fresh”, you’ll have no save game, cash, skills etc. But don’t worry, this has NO effect on your “live” version of the game, you can switch back and forth at any time (see the next point below). Apart from you starting fresh, it should for the most part be identical to the “live” build other than the changes that we want you to test (which we’ll mention further down). 

Note: We DO have a means for you to get up and running quickly in the Trailblazer Beta.  Hit “Escape” and go to the Hunt Club Beta menu, there’ll be a reward there where you can claim a large sum of credits, a big XP boost and weapon score points in all categories.

[h1]I’ve had enough of testing the Open Beta for now, how do I go back to my normal version of the game?[/h1]
Do the initial same steps as when installing the Open Beta, but when you get to the Beta tab you should not fill in a code. Instead in the drop-down box saying “Select the beta you would like to opt into:” you simply pick “None - opt out of all beta programs”” and your client will run a small update. After that you can play the normal version of the game again. You can switch back and forth between the live version and Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme at any time during the period just by using that dropdown menu.

[h1]How do provide feedback or I report issues I’ve found during the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme?[/h1]
Please use our “Beta Feedback” board on the Steam Community Hub here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/

[h1]What do you want us to test?[/h1]
Yay, you’ve made it to the best part! Please see below the changelog for the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme, this will give you some ideas about what to look at specifically when playing on it.

Note: You WILL need ownership to the relevant content on the live version of the game in order to test it in the Open Beta/Trailblazer Programme. For example, new Vurhonga Savanna-specific content would require you owning that particular DLC. That being said, you can of course join a multiplayer hosted game on that reserve should you not own it yourself.

[h1]
[b]Changelog[/b][/h1]

Please pay attention to the following:

[list]
[*] The new animal on Vurhonga Savannah - the Gemsbok.

[*] The new logic of pathfinding for all animals, they should not get stuck or teleport anymore. If you encounter stuck or teleporting animals, or animals that are running in circles please report that.

[*] The new improved and reworked UI. Please tell us if you can’t click a button or you see random text popping up anywhere.

[*] Improved animations on all animals, especially turning will be much smoother, so please look out for animals that look weird.

[*] Smoother matchmaking in multiplayer, if you run into problems, please let us know.
[/list]

Again, please be sure to put any feedback or bug reports you may encounter (ONLY from this beta version of the game) on the new forum here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/13/

Enjoy!

/theHunter: Call of the Wild team

notes.title: How theHunter: Call of the Wild simulates wild animals
notes.notes:
This is The Mechanic, where Alex Wiltshire invites developers to discuss the difficult journeys they ve taken to make their games. This time, theHunter: Call of the Wild [official site].

You ve been tracking the herd for fifteen minutes, and now, finally, you re close enough to see your first deer. You raise your binoculars and edge closer, but a branch scrapes your jacket. The deer s ear twitches and it turns and trots away. You freeze. The deer stops and turns its head to look back in your direction. You crouch but the deer barks, alerting the rest of the herd, and moves on again, disappearing into the undergrowth. The hunt continues.

TheHunter: Call of the Wild is a hunting simulation that goes far beyond anything in a Far Cry or Tomb Raider. Here, you re alone in large expanses of wilderness, following wild animals which live out lives and react to your presence in many complex ways. They re the result of countless hours of AI design and animation that closely model the behaviour of wild beasts, but they re also part of a game, a fact that lends Call of the Wild a fascinating relationship with the natural world. Hello Hunters!

After months of hard work we have some great news to bring out to you! 
The team has been working on a reserve that we know has been requested from theHunter community for a long time. With that being said, we are excited to announce our first African hunting reserve: [b] Vurhonga Savanna! [/b]

Having served as a warden in Layton Lake, Hirschfelden and Medved Taiga - you now return to East Africa at the request of your grandfather, Njabulo Tshabangu, senior warden of Vurhonga Savanna. While you have been away, poachers have forced threatened species like the rhino, elephant and lion to be transferred to a safer location. Their absence has shocked the ecosystem and been lead to disease outbreaks, harming the remaining species. It's up to you to use your unique skills as a hunter to do what you can to bring balance back to the ecology.

[b]List of current species in Vurhonga Savanna:[/b]
- Blue Wildebeest
- Cape Buffalo
- Lesser Kudu
- Scrub Hare
- Side-striped Jackal
- Springbok
- Warthog

[b]We will offer you a first-look at gameplay from the new Vurhonga Savanna reserve on our live-stream, Tuesday 14th of August, 16:00 CEST. Don’t miss out! Tune in at twitch.tv/expansiveworlds or mixer.com/thehuntercallofthewild.[/b]

Hello Hunters,

The first flying animal of theHunter: Call of the Wild, the Canada Goose, has arrived!

The newest addition to theHunter: Call of the Wild’s animal family brings a new and exciting hunting experience to the game. Jump into Hirschfelden and  scout the skies  for skeins (flocks) of Geese in their typical V-formation.
Once you spot a flock, get out of sight and then use the new Canada Goose Short Reed caller to make them break formation and lure them to the ground. As always in hunting, patience is a virtue, so take your time and let them come close. If you manage to stay undetected, the Geese will land around you. Landing and take off, should you spook them after they have landed, are the prime opportunities to take a shot. .
We do not recommend shooting  geese high up in the air as this will spook the flock and most likely won’t hit the bird.

Alternatively, a new Layout blind and Canada Goose decoys allow you to set up the perfect hunting spot. The corn and straw fields are highly recommended as geese avoid landing in forests. The decoys, available in 3 different variations, increase your chances of successfully luring Geese to come to the ground while the layout blind offers better camouflage, overwatching the field. This allows you to lure down geese close to you, pop out of the blind and take aim.

However you choose to hunt geese, the new Strecker SXS 20G Shotgun, loaded with birdshot (also offers buck and slug) is a safe bet for ethical and high scoring hunting. The gun comes in four different variations.  We hope you like it!

The Canada Goose and Canada Goose Short Reed caller are available for free with this update.
The Strecker SXS 20G, Layout blind and Decoys are included in the new “Wild Goose Chase Gear” DLC. We addressed issues regarding placeable items and the beaver and hope that this improves the current situation, please let us know if you still encounter this issue!

Your

notes.title: The Flare Path: A2Z
notes.notes:
A is for A7V action

WWI armour sims are such rare creatures, I can’t bring myself to say anything negative about 79p work-in-progress Cry of War. Currently boasting one tiny cosy map and three tank types (the A7V, Mark IV, and Renault FT), the game combines amateurish quirky presentation and crude forgiving movement physics with surprisingly sophisticated ballistics (shells can ricochet… system damage is determined by post-penetration trajectories) and the best ‘tip’ ever to appear on a military game loading screen. Disarmingly honest developer ShanghaiWindy will be coding around his university commitments, hence the 3-4 year Early Access period. (more…)

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/6feb64575543ed37377d5afbce8b780a01cd888a.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

During the last few months, we’ve been hard at work on integrations of our branches, which will allow for faster development and releases of new content in the future. While this is going to improve the experience for all players, our push to get it done has also meant a recent break in our continuous rollout of PC patches.
 
With this work mostly done, we are now aiming to once again pick up the pace with more frequent PC updates. This patch will lay down the groundwork for everything that is on the horizon.

This first update mainly focuses on changes “under the hood” in order to get ready for the next updates, including the previously announced Jackrabbit. That being said, some issues will be addressed in this patch already. Animal teleportation has been a big focus for us, and this patch aims to solve the “zipping” of animals. We will continue our work on areas that affect this unwanted animal behavior and aim to have more updates going forward.

All outposts now feature interiors and can thus be entered. This was already possible in Medved-Taiga and is now also available in Layton Lake and Hirschfelden. Enjoy those cozy log cabins!

This update also takes in improvements for user interface that have only been available on the console version so far.

Last but not least we invite everyone to celebrate the Lantern Festival with us on March 2. The Lantern Festival marks the end of the Chinese New Year spring festival period and is traditionally celebrated with family, friends, and of course, lanterns! For a limited time, you can find decorations at every outpost in the game, and we wish everybody good fortune!

As always you can find all changes below and do let us know your feedback!

Happy Hunting
theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

notes.title: Update 1.17 - Lantern Festival
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/6feb64575543ed37377d5afbce8b780a01cd888a.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

During the last few months, we’ve been hard at work on integrations of our branches, which will allow for faster development and releases of new content in the future. While this is going to improve the experience for all players, our push to get it done has also meant a recent break in our continuous rollout of PC patches.
 
With this work mostly done, we are now aiming to once again pick up the pace with more frequent PC updates. This patch will lay down the groundwork for everything that is on the horizon.

This first update mainly focuses on changes “under the hood” in order to get ready for the next updates, including the previously announced Jackrabbit. That being said, some issues will be addressed in this patch already. Animal teleportation has been a big focus for us, and this patch aims to solve the “zipping” of animals. We will continue our work on areas that affect this unwanted animal behavior and aim to have more updates going forward.

All outposts now feature interiors and can thus be entered. This was already possible in Medved-Taiga and is now also available in Layton Lake and Hirschfelden. Enjoy those cozy log cabins!

This update also takes in improvements for user interface that have only been available on the console version so far.

Last but not least we invite everyone to celebrate the Lantern Festival with us on March 2. The Lantern Festival marks the end of the Chinese New Year spring festival period and is traditionally celebrated with family, friends, and of course, lanterns! For a limited time, you can find decorations at every outpost in the game, and we wish everybody good fortune!

As always you can find all changes below and do let us know your feedback!

Happy Hunting
theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

KNOWN ISSUES: 

Tents are appearing in the wrong locations in-game (too high/in the ground). We are currently working on a hotfix to address that, apologies for the inconvenience caused.

For the Chinese localized version of the client text is displaying incorrectly, this too is currently being addressed.

notes.title: BATTLE OF THE RESERVES - We Have A Winner!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/dc0e60646dacd18ece4dd629b1c0833716e4b506.png[/img]

With a final harvest total of 106,949 vs 93,556, the community have crowned [b]LAYTON LAKE DISTRICT[/b] as the community favorite!
 
As promised, we’re ending this week on a high note and announcing some exciting upcoming content for Layton Lake District, namely the Jackrabbit! This most recent inhabitant of our Pacific Northwestern reserve is bigger than its distant cousin, the rabbit you know (and hopefully love) from Hirschfelden, it has a completely unique set of new animations and most importantly – it’s fully huntable and harvestable!
 
The Jackrabbit will be released into Layton Lake District as a [b]FREE[/b] update for all platforms (PC, Xbox One, PS4), with the release date to be announced shortly. But, you might ask, with which weapon do I successfully hunt the Jackrabbit? More on that, and some other goodies, coming up soon.
 
We have a bit more news to share today. PC users, please keep your eyes peeled for a small quality of life (bug fix) patch next week. In the console world, we are of course still hard at work to bring you Medved-Taiga (paid DLC) and the accompanying free game update.
 
Great work from everybody taking part in the competition, and congrats to Team Layton Lake! Don’t be sad though Team Hirschfelden, we’ll surely have something fun for you at a later date. ;)

/theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

notes.title: Happy Birthday To theHunter: Call of the Wild!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

As some of you likely know already, theHunter: Call of the Wild turns 1 year old today!

It’s of course been a busy year for us, but the true stars are you, our community.  Not only have you been bagging some big trophy animals, you’ve also racked up some quite interesting statistics, more on that in a moment!

We have an exciting 2nd year planned. Beginning with our Medved-Taiga release for consoles (announce date coming soon), and a bugfix patch in the near future for PC (hoping to make those pesky teleporting animals a thing of the past!), and some really fun content in the following weeks and months.

Please do drop by and say “Hi” during our birthday stream around an hour from now (16:00 CET  twitch.tv/expansiveworlds or mixer.com/thehuntercallofthewild). The word is that the elusive “Producer Phil” may make an appearance, and we’ll talk about a way that YOU can decide which reserve gets the next content announcement, it’s going to be fun!

Again, thank you for supporting us, and just being generally awesome hunters for this first year. Now, on to those fun statistics. ;)  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/92f12841503b278faa47fe9b759ba31f3e2dce75.png[/img]

notes.title: A Message from the Team - 2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/63bd0ef1802a6474860c72022a9130708dacf500.png[/img]

Dear Hunters,

2017 is coming to an end, and with this we celebrate 10 months of theHunter: Call of the Wild with you.

A genuine and big thank you to all hunters out there who made it possible for us to write this message. We enjoy working with you very much and we are humbled and grateful to have such a dedicated and passionate community. This year has been a wild ride, full of lessons and feedback for the next one, which we can’t wait to kick off together with you.

More than 30 patches have been released this year, with bug fixes, improvements, new content and more. From the Bearclaw Lite up to the Hunt Club, we try to bring you something better and new every other week. 
Our work is far from finished and you are helping us to make this a better hunting game for everyone. While working on new things, we will not neglect core gameplay. We will continue to make improvements to existing systems, behaviours and much more. Our goal is to be swifter, more thorough and precise with these improvements, especially once all platforms (PC and consoles) are up to the same patch level.

In terms of next year, we have heard your feedback loud and clear. More animals and more variation on existing animals, as well as equipment such as weapons, is big on our list. We also have some aces up our sleeve! Expect things never seen before in theHunter.
Stay tuned for more details as we roll them out once they get closer to being reality.

Until then we wish you a fantastic end to this year, a great and healthy holiday, and of course plentiful game to hunt! Most of us will be taking a small break and return early next year to continue where we left off - even stronger than before.

Thank you for being part of this journey so far and we are looking forward to continuing the hunt together with you.

Should you have some time over the holidays we’d really appreciate you taking part in our survey, you can find it [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfiq5evywGi6xtIHv2ou73wuop4Ujj2Z4RJVTd2THhUGu3fog/viewform]Here[/url]. Now’s your chance to really steer our development direction just the way you’d like!

notes.title: A Message from the Team - 2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/63bd0ef1802a6474860c72022a9130708dacf500.png[/img]

Dear Hunters,

2017 is coming to an end, and with this we celebrate 10 months of theHunter: Call of the Wild with you.

A genuine and big thank you to all hunters out there who made it possible for us to write this message. We enjoy working with you very much and we are humbled and grateful to have such a dedicated and passionate community. This year has been a wild ride, full of lessons and feedback for the next one, which we can’t wait to kick off together with you.

More than 30 patches have been released this year, with bug fixes, improvements, new content and more. From the Bearclaw Lite up to the Hunt Club, we try to bring you something better and new every other week. 
Our work is far from finished and you are helping us to make this a better hunting game for everyone. While working on new things, we will not neglect core gameplay. We will continue to make improvements to existing systems, behaviours and much more. Our goal is to be swifter, more thorough and precise with these improvements, especially once all platforms (PC and consoles) are up to the same patch level.

In terms of next year, we have heard your feedback loud and clear. More animals and more variation on existing animals, as well as equipment such as weapons, is big on our list. We also have some aces up our sleeve! Expect things never seen before in theHunter.
Stay tuned for more details as we roll them out once they get closer to being reality.

Until then we wish you a fantastic end to this year, a great and healthy holiday, and of course plentiful game to hunt! Most of us will be taking a small break and return early next year to continue where we left off - even stronger than before.

Thank you for being part of this journey so far and we are looking forward to continuing the hunt together with you.

Should you have some time over the holidays we’d really appreciate you taking part in our survey, you can find it [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfiq5evywGi6xtIHv2ou73wuop4Ujj2Z4RJVTd2THhUGu3fog/viewform]Here[/url]. Now’s your chance to really steer our development direction just the way you’d like!

Happy Hunting and all the best
theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

notes.title: Hunt Club Beta - Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

we wanted to give you a bit more insight into how the Hunt Club Beta is performing, what changes have been made and how the payout of rewards will work regarding these changes.

First of all, we are very happy and thankful that many of you jumped directly into the Hunt Club Beta! This is only the beginning, but it is vastly more helpful to develop the feature alongside all of you, than in an isolated development environment.

We had a couple of hiccups during launch, but thanks to the weekend dedication of Calle, our Back End programmer, the system seems to be holding its ground so far.
Initial feedback has been excellent, based on early findings we’ll put more work into making the feature easier to understand, easier to read and will look into what other rewards are possible among other things. Thanks a lot for all the suggestions and discussions and please do keep them coming!

We are currently seeing an issue for our Chinese hunters who can’t participate in the Hunt Club Beta. Your participation is not registered by the system, which also does not let you claim rewards. We don’t have a solution yet, but we’ve located the cause of the issue and will continue to investigate a potential solution.

Rest assured that you will receive the .270 Stradivarius if the community succeeds in reaching the goal. You might receive it a bit later than the rest, but you will get it.

In regard that so many hunters can’t participate in the Holiday Event, we decided to reduce the needed harvests from 300.000 to 200.000.
This change should already be visible in your Hunt Club if you look at the number of needed harvests. Please note that the progress bar might not update this change correctly.

As a final update, the leaderboard segment of the Hunt Club Beta has been taken down for the time being. We’ve received plenty of data and feedback to work with and appreciate all of your contributions.  Watch this space for the next version in 2018

More events will go live throughout December, so please do check out the Hunt Club on a daily basis.

Happy Hunting and thank you,

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

notes.title: Hunt Club (Beta) - Holiday Event 2017
notes.notes:
We’re extremely excited to give all of our PC players access to the Hunt Club Beta this holiday season! Once the feature is live, players will be able to participate in new time-limited events every day and unlock great rewards. Earn bonus XP, money, and even a brand new weapons by participating in events!

To cap everything off, we are running a community-wide event with an amazing prize for everyone who contributes: the .270 STRADIVARIUS, a premium engraved variation of the .270 HUNTSMAN.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/3b6fa7d6ae7fb3dc7bd3ccfcc0b10a1b615e5c4d.png[/img]

To participate in the community holiday event, simply launch or join a multiplayer game and harvest an animal that was downed by a single shot. Once the community has contributed 200,000 harvests, every player will receive this brand new rifle.

Do your part and help the Call of the Wild community unlock this gorgeous weapon by joining the event!

In addition to the main event, there will be new daily events beginning every day at 9:00am CET and concluding at 9:00am CET the next day. Every daily event has 3 reward tiers. You can claim your rewards from the Completed Events Section of the Hunt Club menu after reaching that tier.

To claim rewards from the Hunt Club, go to the Hunt Club sidebar in the in-game options, and claim it from the COMPLETED EVENTS section. You can claim rewards from the Hunt Club as soon as you complete events. Be sure to remember that many events have multiple tiers with greater rewards for each tier.

As always, let us know what you think and happy hunting!

notes.title: Patch 1.15 - Multiplayer Spotting is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/867464710b7619e6d7f003a35bf58eb13ca71570.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

First, we want to welcome all new hunters that picked up the game during the autumn sale.  Thank you very much for giving the game a go, and welcome!

Today’s patch is mostly about maintenance and small game improvements.  Here’s some highlights:

*  Spotting animals in Multiplayer will now highlight the spotted animals for all players around the spotter. We hope this will make spotting more useful when playing with other hunters and are looking forward to your feedback.

*  The checks for animals getting stuck, especially at cliffs like the crater in the Medved-Taiga, have been improved. They should not simply disappear any longer.

*  We had some feedback from the community that the 12-gauge shotgun could give a little bit more “bang for your buck” (pun intended!), as such the 12-Gauge Buckshot’s damage has been increased per pellet and should pack a bigger punch now.

Additionally thanks to community reports the patch also features another round of fixes and improvements for missions - thank you very much for your consistent feedback and reporting!

As always, thank you very much for your feedback and let us know what you think about the latest changes.  Scroll down for the full release notes.

Happy Hunting

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

-------------------------------------------

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[list][*]Multiplayer Spotting - When you spot an animal with your binoculars, all players in your proximity also see that animal highlighted in the game world.

[*]Animals no longer get stuck in cliffs

[*]Increased the 12-Gauge Buckshot’s base damage per pellet[/list]


[h1]Missions[/h1]

[list][*]MEETING GEORGY GRANKIN - implemented a fix for a bug that was blocking people from completing the mission if they had picked up Grankin’s shotgun before that objective was highlighted

[*]JÄGER #4 - removed the distance requirement for this mission

[*]SOMMER #7 - changed the required location from Spreeberg Castle to Spreeberg

[*]DOC #9 - changed the required location from Kraken Highs to Mount Kraken and removed the weight requirement

[*]HOPE #5 - changed the harvested animal from blacktail deer to whitetail deer

[*]BIOLOGICAL CONTAMINANTS #2 - changed hunting location from P’yanyy Forest to Lesnye Lands[/list]


NOTE:  You will not be able join multiplayer games of those running a lower version of the game, please ensure that you and the host are both up to date with patches should you have an issue.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.14
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/90f4ccdacd4de639b59341940534011206593dfd.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

The Halloween content is ending today and is being patched out along with improvements to the game.
We hope you enjoyed this seasonal event and we want to thank everyone for participating and sharing their feedback!

In terms of improvements, today’s patch brings balancing to missions, pooping Red Deer, fixed Thoriac Spine shots on Moose, better clue handling and more.
Have a look at the list below for the full changes and let us know what you think!

Happy Hunting!
[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]


[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Red Deer will now poop correctly
[*]Old clues from actively tracked animals no longer disappear randomly
[*]Fixed Thoraic Spine shots on Moose
[*]Keymapping for bringing up the chat window now works correctly
[*]Bow and arrow of other players are now held in their different hands
[*]Huntermate no longer stops working for guests in a multiplayer session
[*]Additional animations for bears when spooked[/list]

[b]Missions[/b]
[list][*]THE WERECOYOTE - Fixed an issue where the Werecoyote was not spawning for some players
[*]THE ANCESTORS’ PRAYER - Fixed an issue where players who had previously unlocked the sacred landmark were blocked from progressing in the mission
[*]CONNI #10 - Removed the game score requirement
[*]SOMMER #7  - Changed the location requirement from Spreeberg Castle to Spreeberg, the game score requirement from "GOLD or greater" to "SILVER or greater,” and the required amount of harvests from 2 to 3
[*]BHANDARI #3  - Removed the game score requirement
[*]FLEISCHER #3 - Removed game score requirement and changed the mission to require 2 harvests instead of just 1
[*]FLEISCHER #5  - Changed the location from Jonsdorf Lake to Jonsdorf and the weight requirement from 120 to 180 or greater
[*]HOPE #7  - Changed the harvest animal from blacktail deer to whitetail deer
[*]HOPE #8  - Removed shotgun requirement and changed the required amount of harvests from 1 to 2
[*]DOC #7  - Removed score requirement
[*]DOC #18  - Updated the objective description to include the bow requirement
[*]VUALEZ #9 - Removed game score requirement
[*]CONNORS #10  - Changed the total score requirement from GOLD to SILVER
[*]BEATTY #7  - Changed weight requirement from 650 to 520[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list][*]Adjusted volumes for animal vegetation passthrough
[*]Improved syncing of reload animations for shotguns (every skill level)[/list]

[b]User Interface[/b]
[list][*]Default track colors on Layton Lake District get set correctly now 
[*]Pressing the button to bring up the map (Default: M) will bring up the map directly
[*]Mission Log is no longer accessible in Multiplayer
[*]Multiplayer Menu is no longer accessible in Singleplayer
[*]Added chat message in multiplayer when players drown
[*]Pending gender changes no longer revert when equipping / unequipping backpacks[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list][*]Switching reserves no longer brings up 2 loading screens
[*]Various crash fixes[/list]

notes.title: Medved-Taiga: Introducing Alena
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/ec9db380468dcef5f6a699413f1ca4034072bfb8.png[/img]

[h1]Khada Alena Khasavovna[/h1]

My name is Khada Alena Khasavovna, but you can call me Alena. I will be your contact for this cross-disciplinary expedition to Medved-Taiga National Park.

I grew up among the Nenets, reindeer herders who have lived on the taiga since before the Russians. My traditional upbringing brought me closer to nature than most people will ever understand. And over the years, I became aware that the land was changing, rapidly, and not always in beneficial ways. The Nenets do not have the science to cope with these changes. So, I left my people to get an education and learn the sciences, so that I might come back to the taiga to help find solutions to the crises of climate change. This expedition is supposed to be my realization of that goal, but we have suffered so many setbacks, I think Mother Taiga may be working against us. Hopefully with the arrival of a new team and a world-class hunter, we can make a positive difference.

- Alena

notes.title: Species List - Medved-Taiga National Park
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We can imagine you are all keen to see what kind of wildlife you can expect to find in the upcoming Medved-Taiga reserve, so as such we put together a nice breakdown below.  Read on to see which animals you can expect to see on your hunt.

Oh, we also have an extra critter you might see running about, the weasel!

[b]Reindeer[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/059590a8366de25d76812ac31b518a97c2d9e013.jpg[/img]

The reindeer, also known as caribou in North America, is a species of deer native to arctic, subarctic, tundra, boreal, and mountainous regions of northern Europe, Siberia, and North America. Reindeer vary considerably in colour and size and both male or female can grow antlers, with the male's tending to be considerably larger.


[b]Moose[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/afbb9ee0c8a9f8112f1b952c18d427a79e51d702.jpg[/img]

The moose is the largest extant species in the deer family. Moose are distinguished by the broad, flat (or palmate) antlers of the males. Moose typically inhabit boreal forests and temperate broadleaf and mixed forests of the Northern Hemisphere in temperate to subarctic climates.

[b]Musk Deer[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/058ddea19387d420b1cc11863e65b67c85ad403d.jpg[/img]

Musk deer resemble small deer with a stocky build, and hind legs longer than their front legs. They are about 80 to 100 cm (31 to 39 in) long, 50 to 70 cm (20 to 28 in) high at the shoulder, and weigh between 7 and 17 kg (15 and 37 lb). These deer have no antlers, but the males do have enlarged upper canines, forming sabre-like tusks.

[b]Brown Bear[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/649548c856689d253d8aaf2fd5988051218a37b8.jpg[/img]

The brown bear is a large bear with the widest distribution of any living ursid. The species is distributed across much of northern Eurasia and North America. It is one of the two largest terrestrial carnivorans alive today, rivaled in body size only by its close cousin, the polar bear.

[b]Wild Boar[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/7133728aaeb854a7a60d4e3fb60984accfb0e6e0.jpg[/img]

The wild boar, also known as the wild swine or Eurasian wild pig, is native to much of Eurasia, North Africa, and the Greater Sunda Islands. Human intervention has spread its distribution further, making the species one of the widest-ranging mammals in the world. Its wide range, high numbers, and adaptability mean that it has continued to flourish in the wild

[b]Lynx[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/b0e98b943f8d00eb41d829e1a528c6dbcb6a05d9.jpg[/img]

Lynx have a short tail, characteristic tufts of black hair on the tips of their ears, large, padded paws for walking on snow and long whiskers on the face. Under their neck, they have a ruff which has black bars resembling a bow tie although this is often not visible.  Being extremely intelligent and in possession of excellent senses, these are sure to be a challenge to hunt!

Feel free to join the discussion about our newest upcoming hunting reserve here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1473096694452504809/

Which of these animals are you most excited to find on your first visit to Medved-Taiga?

/Graham

notes.title: New Reserve Revealed! First Look at Medved-Taiga.
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters!

Big thanks to those of you who took part in our guessing games last week, now it's time for your efforts to pay off!

As many of you correctly guessed, we are taking you to cooler climes with our next big content release. Our next DLC (optional, paid content) will be a whole new reserve for you to explore, the Medved-Taiga National Park! Inspired by the frozen landscape of Siberia, Medved-Taiga gives hunters an entirely new experience to enjoy.

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.11.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/ffc87cae21edd95b5d08f17d7e05fc3e794885aa.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Patch 1.11.1 is here and brings a number of new fixes to the game - we hope you’ll enjoy them! We have addressed one of the biggest issues concerning animal behavior and reactions not working as intended, sometimes making them move in a circle rather than fleeing or following a logical path. We also continued to work with a lot of your feedback to further improve the issue of disappearing tents. Please have a look at the list below for a detailed overview of all improvements introduced by this patch.
[list]
[*]Fix for a crash when entering the southwest corner of Hirschfelden.
[*]Fix for possible crash when a player leaves a multiplayer game while seated on an ATV.
[*]Fix for network de-sync when players leave a multiplayer game, causing animals to stop reacting to players.
[*]Fix for animals sometimes running in circles or not reacting to players.
[*]Additional improvements for disappearing tents.
[*]Fix for unlocalized item descriptions for bows in the store screen.
[*]Fix for rain sounds stuttering near certain areas in the game.
[*]Fix for a message about driving an ATV into the water showing for all players in a multiplayer game.
[/list]
Let us know what you think about this hotfix in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1473095965287785867/?tscn=1504722947/]Patch 1.11 feedback thread[/url]. 

Happy Hunting,

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

EDIT: The reason why the patch is 1.8GB is that we have re-modeled some parts of the landscape to fix related crashes. These changes are very heavy in file size.

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.11
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/07fa5d8223f2345c9d326a535fa882114e1bf164.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Patch 1.11 is here and brings a wide variety of new fixes to the game that we hope you’ll enjoy!

Backpacks have arrived as a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/706150/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Backpacks/]free DLC and are now available[/url] in the Steam store! They allow you to carry more equipment and are visible on your character. 

Manual Reload and Chambering now allows for greater control over your shots and weapons. The resulting slightly reduced recoil will help you to better track the hit reactions of animals. You can find these two options in the Game settings.

The inventory system has been reworked with the aim to make it a lot more intuitive to use for both keyboards as well as game pads. Item highlighting, for example, will make it easier and much faster to get an overview of which equipment and ammunition are compatible with your carried weapons.

We’ve added additional fixes to disappearing tents and ground blinds, while also adding a check so that every player always has at least 5 tents and 5 ground blinds (counting across storage, inventory and placed in the world) owned at any time. We will monitor how this works - please let us know what you think in the feedback thread.

On top of the above mentioned, this patch introduces many more fixes such as temporal antialiasing (find it in the Graphics settings), balancing of missions, fixes for bleeding rates and animal behaviour, a new death sequence when the player dies, new animations for bears, automated codex entries when interacting with point of interests, and much more.

As always you can find the full list of changes below and we are looking forward to your feedback in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1473095965287785867/]dedicated forum thread for Patch 1.11[/url]. 

Happy Hunting

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Manual Reload[/b]
Enabling the ‘Manual Reload’ option in the Game settings allows you to manually reload your weapons. Once your magazine clip is empty, it won’t be reloaded automatically if the option is enabled. 
[*][b]Manual Chambering[/b]
Enabling the ‘Manual Chambering’ option in the Game settings allows you to manually chamber the next shot. After taking a shot, you then easily chamber the next bullet by pressing the reload button.This will allow you to better track your shots and the hit reactions of animals.
[*]Temporal Anti-Aliasing
[/list]
[h1]Missions[/h1]
[list]
[*]A Family Picture: changed objective from taking a photo of 2 bears in one photo to a two photos of 2 different bears.
[*]Jäger #4: changed deer rank requirement from GOLD to SILVER and added a distance requirement
[*]Jäger #7: changed deer rank condition from GOLD to SILVER
[*]Sommer #2: removed the high scoring animal requirement. 
[*]Sommer #7: changed the amount of GOLD score roe deer harvests needed from 4 to 2
[*]Beatty #4: changed trophy rating from GOLD to SILVER and tweaked photography parameters to make it easier to take a suitable photo
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Animal bleed rates were adjusted 
[*]Animals no longer get stuck when luring them to an outpost
[*]Animals no longer leave trails of need zones
[*]Improved fleeing behaviour of animals with less running in circles (this will be tweaked further in the future)
[*]Added player death sequence and ragdoll
[*]Updated hit reaction and injured animations for bears
[*]Fixed display bug with “Ranger” perk regarding distances
[/list]
[h1]Tents and Ground Blinds[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added check for players to always have at least 5 Tents and 5 Ground Blinds (combined between your storage, inventory and in the world)
[/list]
[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Inventory System
[*]Improved rendering of in-game player names
[*]Codex is now opened automatically when interacting with landmarks and cairns - this also works retroactively
[*]Added player death notifications in the chat log
[*]Player name colors now match player icons on the map
[*]Scrolling with the mouse wheel while the map is hidden no longer affects the zoom level of the map
[*]New message displaying when player have been kicked from a multiplayer game
[*]Added contextual help for ATV when entering for the first time
[*]Added setting to display/hide the HUD.
[*]Multiplayer harvest messages in the chat will now display the accumulated harvest score for the animal harvested instead of the base animal score.
[*]Fixed issue where the player’s heart rate would get inappropriately updated while on an ATV
[/list]
[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*]ATVs now create sounds when passing through vegetation like bushes
[*]Exchanged the voice over line for “There is a track nearby”
[/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Anti-Aliasing graphical setting
[*]Fixed hand textures on female variation #5
[*]Terrain tessellation now correctly matches physics settings after changing map
[*]Travel-related achievements will now work correctly for new players
[*]Fixed one issues that could cause the game to freeze
[/list]
[h1]Tobii[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixes for crashes related to Extended View
[/list]

Hello Hunters,

When you venture out into the wilderness one of the most crucial things will always be to have enough storage space for items, weapons or ammunition. In order to give you more freedom the Reserve Wardens have ordered a full range of backpacks and daypacks which are now available to all hunters in the in-game store. 

The new backpacks and daypacks come in different variations, sizes, capacities, and colors. They allow you to carry more equipment but also slightly increase your characters’ visibility and noise level when travelling on foot. 

In order to access them [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/706150/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Backpacks/]activate the free Backpacks DLC[/url] in Steam before you start the game. And don’t forget to hit the “Accept” button after selecting them in the menu, before leaving the store.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/15cad3002714ddf8bdcadc2da5ac3d8c131d024a.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

When you venture out into the wilderness one of the most crucial things will always be to have enough storage space for items, weapons or ammunition. In order to give you more freedom the Reserve Wardens have ordered a full range of backpacks and daypacks which are now available to all hunters in the in-game store. 

The new backpacks and daypacks come in different variations, sizes, capacities, and colors. They allow you to carry more equipment but also slightly increase your characters’ visibility and noise level when travelling on foot. 

In order to access them [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/706150/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Backpacks/]activate the free Backpacks DLC[/url] in Steam before you start the game. And don’t forget to hit the “Accept” button after selecting them in the menu, before leaving the store.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/6878aa3da73b9fb58796747bd04479a1827dd964.png[/img]

Happy Hunting!

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

notes.title: Introducing Community Manager Graham
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

We are very happy to introduce a new member of the Expansive Worlds team to you. Graham joined us last week as Community Manager for theHunter: Classic and Call of the Wild and he will work alongside Stefan. We’re sure you’re excited to meet him, so here comes his official introduction:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/0f1b9be252e02fea273b7ca47a3cf4ea41d3cbfa.jpg[/img]

[i]Hi all!

I’ve recently started at Expansive Worlds and Avalanche Studios, and after a week of finding my feet (and bagging many many digital turkeys), I feel now is as good a time as any to introduce myself!

My name is Graham and I’ll be joining Stefan as Community Manager for theHunter Classic and theHunter: Call of the Wild.  I’ve been rattling around the video games industry in one form or another since 2006 (most recently with Avalanche’s neighbour Paradox Interactive) and have counted myself as very fortunate to do something I love for so long!

Originally hailing from the New Forest National Park in England, I was raised around nature and hunting, so I’m really excited to get involved with theHunter games and the surrounding community.  I know a lot of you are equally as passionate about hunting in the real world as you are in Whiteheart Island or Hemmeldal!

I look forward to getting to know a lot of you better over the coming weeks and months, beginning with our regular weekly stream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/expansiveworlds/]Twitch[/url] at 4PM (16:00) CEST tomorrow in fact.  

Hope to see you all there![/i]

Make sure to say hello to Graham here or in the official theHunter forum!

Happy Hunting,

theHunter Team

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.10
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/8352fe6d14e306419356e3712270500f94807cae.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

We're excited to finally release the first big patch after the summer break, introducing some major improvements to multiplayer as well as other areas of the game. 

In general multiplayer updates can be challenging as testing them is complex. The issues can have several different reasons for happening and even though we feel confident enough to release the patch we will monitor game data, and your reports, to make sure that we catch any additional problems. As always, your feedback is very important to us and we are looking forward to it!

So what is new in Patch 1.10? Well, glad you asked! Progressing with friends is now more convenient, as all players in a multiplayer game are able to claim and unlock outposts, lookout towers and hunting structures. Additional improvements to host migration and networking will prevent issues like invincible animals, animals not spawning, equipment disappearing and more.

Some other highlights are customizable track colors (helpful for players suffering from deuteranopia i.e. red-green color blindness), a new chat window, new predator “distressed” caller and a new setting to hide the HUD. You can find the full patch notes below. We hope you enjoy the update and let us know what you think in the dedicated [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/2183537632737145117/]Patch 1.10 forum thread[/url]. 

Happy Hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]All players in a multiplayer game are now able to claim and unlock outposts, lookout towers and hunting structures. Any outpost, lookout tower or hunting structure claimed by another player still needs to be claimed by you in order to use its functionality (e.g. resting, store, etc.) Structures that have been claimed by other players in a multiplayer session are now marked as “Ghost” models for better indication.
[*]Your progress will be carried over to singleplayer and any future multiplayer game.
[*]Improved updating of animal health in multiplayer
[*]Overhauled host migration
[*]Major improvements to network functionality in order to prevent random issues in multiplayer (e.g. invincible animals, animals not spawning, equipment disappearing and more) 
[*]Fixed issue where the heart rate indicator would not function properly when in multiplayer games.
[/list]
We took a big sweep at multiplayer in this update, mostly focusing on how you play and progress together. These won’t be the last improvements in multiplayer as getting more data from you is very important for fixing and improving this aspect of the game. We will closely monitor the results to keep improving multiplayer.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with lost Huntermate in Multiplayer and Singleplayer
[*]Improved ATV suspension to prevent wheels from offsetting
[*]Fixed a bug that caused weapons to pop in and out of the player’s hands
[/list]
[b]Tents and Ground Blinds[/b]
[list]
[*]Ground blinds no longer disappear when buying them from a nearby tent
[*]Fixed issue with tents and ground blinds sometimes disappearing for some players in multiplayer games
[/list]
[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*]Added setting for color variations to active / inactive tracks and collectibles
[*]Chat window has received an overhaul
[*]HUD can now be enabled / disabled in the Settings
[*]Settings are now correctly saved when exiting the navigation strip
[*]Added Weapon Score information to Hunter Profile Card
[*]Unlimited ammunition is no longer displayed when entering the shooting range with a weapon without ammunition
[*]Skill points now center correctly in the skill node
[*]Setting the compass to “fixed” now works properly with only the needle rotating
[*]Headings in the multiplayer game browser are now localised
[*]Current time when resting no longer misses zeroes 
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased volume for ATVs
[*]New sound for Predator - “Distressed” caller
[*]Decreased volume of footsteps in water when sneaking
[*]Adjusted volume of first aid kit in multiplayer based on distance to user
[*]Rain at Petershain Fields now plays properly
[*]Characters no longer play audio during loading screens
[*]Improved breathing sounds for male characters while running
[*]Decreased volume of breathing for female characters while running
[*]Added holstering sounds for rifles
[*]Zooming in our out with rifle scopes no longer skips the click when done too quickly
[/list]

Hello hunters,

We’re back with another community competition where you have the chance to win awesome prizes! This time it’s all about the ATVs and we want you to make a video to show us your best trick/funniest situation/coolest stunt or any other moment that you want to share. 

[b]Guidelines[/b]
[list][*]Make a video of your best moment with the ATV in theHunter: Call of the Wild. 
[*]Maximum video length is 30 seconds.
[*]Upload your video to YouTube and post the link in this thread.
[*]Please note that the video may not contain any copyrighted music/images or offensive language/content. You can find selections of royalty free music online.

[*]If a contribution contains profane/offensive language and/or copyrighted material it will be automatically disqualified.
[*]We reserve the right to not pick winners if the contributions do not agree with our code of conduct.[/list]

Enjoy and happy recording!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Community Team[/i]

notes.title: SUMMER ANNOUNCEMENT & BEHIND THE SCENES LOOK
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/d8fb90af006af78ea0c64cdebb2c1de6e80c152b.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

It has been a while since our last release, so we wanted to give you an update of how things are 
progressing.

Summer has finally arrived in Stockholm and the majority of our team will take a short break to rest and recharge their batteries before we kick off the second half of the year. It will be a busy time, with the biggest new addition to theHunter: Call of the Wild drawing closer. While a few developers will remain in the studio to continue work on the game, please expect slightly longer response times, and for our live streams to take a two week break.

Looking back at our first 150 days - 20 patches (one almost every week), 18 streams, 3 free DLCs and 2 paid ones have been out since release, so let’s reflect on this hunting journey we’ve embarked on together. First, we could not be happier having you as part of our rapidly growing community. The forums and [url=https://www.facebook.com/thehuntercotw/]social media channels[/url] are bustling with ideas, feedback and suggestions for the future as well as stories about taking down that legendary piebald Moose. Throughout all of these interactions, you have told us know what you like (and what you don’t like!) and we’ve been tweaking our plans accordingly. Together, we keep working toward an even better hunting experience, and surrounding community.

In last week’s stream, we showcased the upcoming features of Patch 1.10, including improved multiplayer progression, customizable colors for active & inactive tracks, a new chat and more. 
We decided to go for “bigger is better” instead of releasing multiplayer progression first, followed by a bug-fixing heavy patch afterwards. So our next update will be a clean-up of many different issues experienced in multiplayer and we will roll it out altogether in the patch. Quality assurance and flawless execution will be crucial for this release so we are taking more time to get it right. Monitoring the patch once it is out will be equally important so expect a release when the team is back in full force in August.

Before we wrap this up, we have a small treat for you - we’ve taken to heart a frequent piece of feedback, calling for a chance to get to know the development team a little better. In this mini documentary, we bring you along to some of our favorite outdoor spots around Stockholm. We talk about developing theHunter: Call of the Wild, try to pinpoint what makes the experience so different from most other games where you wield a weapon, and shoot some actual trap. Here you’ll get a face to some of the names working tirelessly on the game, including Anna Bouveng (Executive Producer), Pim Holfve (CEO of Avalanche Studios) and yours truly. We had a lot of fun being out in the wild filming this, and we hope you enjoy the glimpse into our philosophy of development.

Finally, we can’t wait to show you what else is in store for you and to discuss where to take theHunter: Call of the Wild. Again, thanks for making this game what it is! Here’s to many more long-distance heart shots, surprise animal encounters, breathtaking screenshots and multiplayer sessions with old and new friends. Wishing you all a great summer, with good weather, health, friends and family and maybe the occasional hunting session!

theHunter: Call of the Wild team through Producer Philipp Strecker

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W1Se26vlu5U&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.9.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/4756bda67fbc202309e3b322b432c2b4215c5544.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,
 
As mentioned in yesterday’s patch notes we have some more improvements to release today with patch 1.9.1.
 
Animals no longer think you are on an ATV after dismounting, as their vision was affected. We also introduced further improvements to the repopulation of animals, group behaviour specifically.
 
Tents should no longer disappear and we are working on a solution to compensate for lost ones. More information regarding this will follow soon, we want to make sure that nothing gets lost. 
 
Trophy integrity now only calculates first hits when using weapons shooting multiple projectiles such as shotguns.
 
Time and weather will now only save for the host and will work correctly in multiplayer.
 
Let us know what you think in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1368380934237568822/]dedicated Patch 1.9 forum thread[/url] and enjoy your hunt!
 
Happy Hunting!
 
[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]
 
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Additional improvements to animal spawning so animal groups re-populate correctly
[*]Fixed issue with animal vision not updating when players dismount the ATV
[*]Trophy integrity now calculates only with first hits when using weapons shooting multiple projectiles (e.g. shotguns)
[/list]
[h1]Tents and Ground Blinds[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bugfix for disappearing Tents and Ground Blinds 
 [/list]
[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*]Time and weather now works correctly in multiplayer and saves only for the host
[/list] 
[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved readability on the Shooting Range scoreboard
[*]Fixed text cut off of speed-o-meter in simplified Chinese
[/list]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Simplified Chinese Text Localization Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/6f94a1ee43c05101a62db061651284ffc0f82c98.png[/img]
 
Hello Hunters,
 
We are thrilled to announce that [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/518790/announcements/detail/1341359336473403633/]Patch 1.9[/url] was just released! This patch introduces several new bug fixes, and also localizes the game to Simplified Chinese. Both the main game and all released DLC’s now feature the option to pick Simplified Chinese as the text language. To mark the special occasion, we have also added a Chinese translation to the announcement text below.
 
Over the past months, our localization team has been hard at work in order to bring the Chinese language into the world of theHunter. The Chinese community has been very passionate about the game for a long time, and we feel a full text-localization is a major step towards bringing an even more immersive game experience to all Chinese-speaking hunters. 
 
You can change the language to Simplified Chinese by right-clicking on the game in your Steam library, then selecting ‘Properties’ and the tab ‘Languages’. There you can choose Simplified Chinese from the drop-down menu and the localization files will be automatically downloaded. Please note that the language for customer support as well as social media and Steam forums will still be English.
 
Currently, there is one aspect of the Chinese language version which is not yet working as intended. Unfortunately, the multiplayer chat function  does not currently support Simplified Chinese text input. Our development team is aware of this and is looking into possible solutions. We will inform all players when we have more news to share.

You may have to restart Steam in order to select the new language.
 
Happy Hunting,
 
[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i] 
 
-- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- --

在过去几个月，我们在地化团队一直致力于为猎人们带来中文版本的《猎人》。中国社区的玩家对本游戏充满了热情且期盼已久，使我们了解拥有一个完整的在地化游戏内容势在必行，同时引领所有中国猎人们一起体验更身历其境的游戏。
 
在您的Steam库中，以右键点击此游戏，然后依次选择“属性”、“语言”，即可将语言转换为简体中文。你可以在下拉菜单中选择简体中文，即可自动下载在地化文件。请注意，客服的语言以及社交媒体和Steam论坛的语言仍然保留英文。
 
遗憾的是，目前中文版本中有一项功能尚未在地化，即多人聊天功能当前不支持简体中文输入。我们的开发团队早已留意这个问题，并正在寻找可能的解决方案。如有更多消息分享，我们会通知所有玩家。
 
狩猎愉快！
