notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.9
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/aae4b631ecfdb7ebddcf1742e45ad59aa5a7215a.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,
 
We are very happy to see a lot of feedback about the recently released ATV along with footage of your adventures - thank you for creating so much entertaining content!
 
Today, we roll out patch 1.9 with some subtle improvements.
 
On some occasions a vehicle might not be the best option when hunting. Upon creating a multiplayer game, you can now select whether ATVs are permitted or not. A new UI icon will display this when browsing multiplayer games so you can choose what type of hunt you want to go for.
 
Scope crosshairs are now centered and gamepad sensitivity has been improved.
 
Scoreboard as well as harvest screen have received a ‘beauty treatment’ and a codex entry has been added for the ATV to look up controls and more.
 
Additional improvements for ATV audio volume, animal senses, repopulation as well as disappearing tents are being tested and we aim to roll them out as soon as possible!
 
As always, let us know your feedback and what you think in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1368380934237568822/]dedicated forum thread[/url].
 
Happy Hunting! 

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]
 
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with scope crosshair being slightly offset from the actual aim point of the weapon in some scope / weapon combinations
[*]Improved gamepad sensitivity
[*]Fixed looping animation when trying to aim with a first aid kit
[/list]
 
[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added option to not permit ATVs when creating a multiplayer game
[*]Added UI icon whether ATVs are permitted in multiplayer games
[*]Improved interpolation for nametags for smoother movement
[/list]
 
[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved user experience for Harvest Screen
[*]Updated Scoreboard (by default “I” in-game)
[*]Added ATV Codex entry
[/list]
 
[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash related to spooking animals
[*]Fix for various floating objects at the Spreeberg Western Outpost
[*]Various localization fixes
[/list]

We’re very excited to announce that the ‘Saber 4x4 ATV’ DLC is now available! It can be purchased via Steam for $3.99. More detailed information about this new optional DLC can be found on our store page as well as in the initial [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/518790/announcements/detail/1326721370060725300]reveal announcement[/url]. It’s also worth noting that in multiplayer games, only one player needs to own the DLC for all players in that session to be able to drive an ATV. More details in the above link.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/630940/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__ATV_SABER_4X4/

As a gesture of appreciation to our most loyal players, everyone who already owns the “Tents & Ground Blinds” DLC, as well as all the early birds who purchase the brand new [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3745/theHunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Mile_a_Minute_Bundle_Limited_time_offer/]DLC bundle (ATV + Tents & Ground Blinds), will receive a special 30 percent discount.[/url] This is a limited time offer and only available between June 15 and June 22, 9AM CEST.

You can discuss the new Saber 4x4 ATV DLC in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/2119355556478041551/]dedicated forum thread.[/url]

Here you can find instructions on how to spawn the ATV in-game, as well as detailed game controls.
 
[b]Requesting your personal ATV[/b]
 
Vehicles can be requested from the Garage, found in the left-hand menu when accessing the store and cache from outposts and tents. 
 
To request a vehicle, select it in the Garage and press "Request." Your vehicle will be delivered to your location and highlighted with a vehicle icon on your map.
 
You can also recover vehicles that have been requested and left out in the reserves from the Garage. Recovering a vehicle instantly transports it to your location and repairs any damage that it has sustained out in the field.
 
Only one vehicle per player can be in the world at any one time. Requesting an additional vehicle removes the first one.
 
[b]Vehicle controls (default control scheme) / (default gamepad controls)[/b]
Accelerate: W  / Right Trigger 
Brake / Reverse: S / Left Trigger
Turn Left: A / Left Stick - Left
Turn Right: D / Left Stick - Right
Toggle Headlights: L / Right Stick - Press stick
Enter / Exit: E / X
Handbrake: SPACE / B
Look: Mouse / Right Stick
Toggle View: C / D-Pad - Down
 
[b]Accidents[/b]
Vehicles that are upside-down can be flipped back on their wheels by walking up to them and pressing E.
 
Happy Hunting!
 
[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.8
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/a2ad93650dece70c7ea8ae7300961bbdc202f6fe.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,
 
Before we bring you the ATV DLC - which will be out soon - we wanted to release a patch to fix issues that have been of concern to the community.
 
Patch 1.8 introduces the new outposts in both Hirschfelden and Layton Lake while also updating the animal respawn system. This fixes the exploit near Lake Kraken too. Please note that this will remove your discovered need zones. The empty tutorial box that got stuck after harvesting an animal has been fixed as well.
 
After releasing the Shooting Range, players requested improved feedback for shot placement and we are happy to release this feature as well. The terrain on low-quality settings will also no longer obstruct targets, and buttons can only be used from within the control room.
 
Multiplayer is high on our list of improvement areas, and this patch introduces some first steps, but you can expect more of this in the future.
Bullet trajectories and scopes are now correctly synchronized in multiplayer, so you will see exactly where shots of other players land, for all weapons. We made additional changes to how your rewards are communicated when you harvest an animal of a shared takedown. Instead of showing the total rewards, you will now see the rewards you receive based on your participation. Filtering multiplayer games by distance now works correctly and the default amount of players when creating a multiplayer session has been increased to 8.
 
The previously announced adjustments to Tents & Ground Blinds roll out with this patch. Purchasing the Tents & Ground Blinds DLC from now on will grant 5 tents and 5 ground blinds, while players who bought additional tents and / or ground blinds beforehand, will be refunded their in-game currency, corresponding to a maximum of 5 tents and 5 ground blinds.
 
This is not all, as we made balance changes to missions, aiming to make them fairer to complete. As always, you can find the full list below and we are looking forward to your feedback while continuing to improve the game.
 
Let us know what you think about the changes in our 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/2119355556474605026/]dedicated forum thread[/url] and we look forward to bringing you the ATV DLC shortly.
 
Happy Hunting!
 
[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved Shooting Target HUD - As requested by many players, now you can get instant visual feedback about where your bullet lands on the Shooting Range targets so you can further improve your hunting skills!
[*]6 additional outposts have been added to Hirschfelden (will appear revealed on the map if closest lookout tower has been claimed)
[*]7 additional outposts have been added to Layton Lake (will appear revealed on the map if closest lookout tower has been claimed)
[*]You can find a map overview of the new outposts at the bottom of this post
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with the terrain covering targets at the shooting range (low quality settings)
[*]Animals now correctly repopulate after being killed but not harvested
[*]Fixed animal exploit near lake Kraken
[*]No longer possible to trigger toggle target buttons from outside the control room
[*]Fixed issue with lever action giving shotgun stats instead of rifle stats
[*]Fixed issue with aim toggle resetting after confirming an animal
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]Bullet trajectories now work correctly for other players in multiplayer
[*]Scopes are now correctly shown and updated in multiplayer
[*]When harvesting an animal with a shared takedown, players now receive the correct information about their own reward
[*]Filtering multiplayer games by distance now works correctly
[*]Default amount of maximum players when creating a multiplayer game increased from 2 to 8
[*]Additional names for multiplayer competitions
[/list]
[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue in the mission “Jäger - Wrapping Up The Book” where not all objective regions were marked on the map
[*]Tweaked the conditions for completing the photo objectives in “Jäger - [*]Wrapping Up The Book”  to make them easier to complete
[*]Changed the objective in the mission “Conni #18” to require a weapon and distance that makes more sense for the targeted species
[*]Fixed an issue with the mission “Connors - Putting out the fire” where the campfire was burning before the mission had been activated by the player
[*]Fixed an issue where the fire in the mission "Connors - Putting out the fire" failed to show if you exited the fire location and returned to it when the mission was active
[*]Fixed an issue with the mission “Conni #20” where Foxes harvested from ground blinds did not count correctly towards the objective
[*]The mission system no longer gets stuck when quitting or crashing when the last objective of a mission is met
[/list]
[b]User Interface[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with empty tutorial box that is stuck after animal harvest
[*]Longest shot, shot accuracy, shots fired, shots hit and shots missed now track correctly for local player only
[*]Fixed First Aid Key placeholder in contextual tutorial
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with vegetation textures when switching reserves
[*]Fixed issue with the flashlight not being toggleable
[*]Fixed various floating assets
[*]Added vegetation interaction objects to various assets (e.g. grass will be lower around benches and similar objects)
[/list]
[b]Tents & Ground Blinds[/b]
[list]
[*]Number of Tents and Ground Blinds awarded upon DLC purchase increased from 1 to 5
[*]Refunded players who previously bought additional tents and ground blinds for up to 4 additional Tents/Ground Blinds with in-game currency
[*]Vegetation no longer sticks through tents
[/list]

[h1]New outposts on Hirschfelden & Layton Lake District[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/747c311e8cb39bc2b3ee79148be841d63d8bf81e.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/46b9b43c8234c9262386330211f7156d38c1612b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Announcing ATV Saber 4x4 & Patch 1.8
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/00e830b2aca92ef673d059af1f060f874888efce.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,
 
We hope you’ve enjoyed the jigsaw puzzle challenge and are as excited about the upcoming DLC release as we are. As many of you have correctly guessed, we will be adding an All Terrain Vehicle (ATV) to the theHunter: Call of the Wild! The lucky winners of our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/518790/announcements/detail/1326721370049309433]Steam competition[/url] are Bishop, Xi Law, Harkon[DGA], Climply & djiskool. I will reach out to the winners via Steam.
 
The ATV has been a highly requested feature in the theHunter franchise for many years, and with the new Apex technology powering theHunter: Call of the Wild, we finally felt that we could do it justice. The brand new Saber 4x4 ATV will be released soon via Steam for $3.99.

Reveal Trailer:
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ry93SPMvesE&feature=youtu.be
An ATV offers the perfect way to traverse the hunting reserves in a fun, yet efficient way. You can, of course, drive it in singleplayer games, but also in multiplayer. Only one player needs to own the DLC for all of you to enjoy it. Before we get into the details, we just want to be clear that we’re still committed to fair and ethical hunting. To that end, you will never be shooting while you’re riding, and you can’t run down animals as you ride. The ATV was designed as a mode of (really fun!) transportation across great distances.
 
As a gesture of appreciation to our most loyal players, everyone who already owns the “Tents & Ground Blinds” DLC, as well as all the early birds who purchase the brand new 'Mile a minute' DLC bundle (ATV + Tents & Ground Blinds), will receive a 30 percent discount. This is a limited time offer and only available for 7 days after the release of the ATV.
 
As promised, we also have an exciting update, available to everyone. Together with this new optional DLC, we’ll release Patch 1.8 which will contain the regular bug fixes and performance improvements. Additionally, it contains 6 new outposts per reserve, providing additional fast travel options. This is a tweak that many players have asked for, and we feel it will provide a smoother and more enjoyable experience for everyone, regardless if you decide to get the ATV DLC or not.
 
We’ll host a pre-release stream later this week where you can check out the ATV in all of its glory - more information will follow in a separate Steam announcement as well as on [url=https://twitter.com/theHunterCOTW]Twitter[/url].

You can discuss the announcement in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1353742967820589094/]dedicated forum thread[/url].

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

EDIT: The ATV will cost no currency in-game after purchasing the DLC. You will be able to spawn it in from the shop for free.

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Community Challenge - Puzzle & Giveaway
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,
 
Today, we have a lot of exciting news for you! First and foremost, we know that many of you are waiting for Patch 1.8. We’re happy to announce that it will drop next week. More information on all the upcoming fixes will follow.
 
We are also kicking off a new exciting community challenge today. At the end of it, sometime next week, we’ll unveil a new and unique piece of content. What we’re about to roll-out has been one of the most requested features since the announcement of the game. This is a project we started some time ago, and it has required the use of additional resources not to affect our regular schedule including bug fixes – but we hope you’ll agree it has been worth the effort!
 
The content is going to be released as optional paid DLC. It will be available to use in single player games or together with friends in multiplayer – and only one player is required to own the DLC for everyone in the online session to enjoy it. And as a cherry on top, we will make a related tweak that we believe will be appreciated by all hunters.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/b7b2282597af0af1108d1289b79f629b1d62223f.png[/img]
 
Starting today, we will reveal a new piece of the above jigsaw puzzle every day. The daily reveals can be found in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1353742967808618359/]dedicated forum thread[/url], where you can also discuss the challenge and work on solving the riddle together with your fellow hunters. The first 5 players to correctly guess the new content will receive a prize from us after the release.
 
So join us over the next few days and uncover what the new content is! We can’t wait to share it with you.
 
Best of luck and happy hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Community Team[/i]

It will be available to use in single player games or together with friends in multiplayer – and only one player is required to own the DLC for everyone in the online session to enjoy it. And as a cherry on top, we will make a related tweak that we believe will be appreciated by all hunters.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/b7b2282597af0af1108d1289b79f629b1d62223f.png[/img]
 
Starting today, we will reveal a new piece of the above jigsaw puzzle every day. The daily reveals can be found in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1353742967808618359/]dedicated forum thread[/url], where you can also discuss the challenge and work on solving the riddle together with your fellow hunters. So join us over the next few days and uncover what the new content is! We can’t wait to share it with you.
 
Best of luck and happy hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Community Team[/i]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Adjustments and Future Plans for Tents and Ground Blinds
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/aed7f87c01084b7c7750c2d36a91f729b5e888a1.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Following the message regarding our  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/518790/announcements/detail/1299696599439341780/]DLC plan last week[/url], we’ve been in touch with many of you. Some have given us shout-outs for honest communication (thanks, we try!) and others feel we still have a lot of work to do (we’re fully aware and are already on it!). A third group have provided very clear and useful suggestions on how to improve the first paid DLC, ‘Tents and Ground Blinds’.

With this note, we’d like to talk about some adjustments which we hope will be welcome, regardless of which of the above groups you belong to. Here’s what we’re doing, and why:

You’ve let us know that it takes too much work to earn Tents and Ground Blinds in the game, once you’ve bought the DLC. With today’s adjustment, we are lowering the price in the in-game store to 16.000 for Tents and 8.000 for Ground Blinds, compared to the previous price point of 24.000 and 12.000 respectively, to make sure you can fully enjoy you new equipment once you’ve purchased the DLC.

In the near future, we are planning to increase the amount of Tents and Ground Blinds that you get right away when purchasing the DLC, from one of each, to 5 Tents and 5 Ground Blinds. We don’t have an ETA yet, but the Development Team is working on this right now. Players who bought Tents and/or Ground Blinds before this in-game price reduction will be refunded for spent in-game currency, corresponding to a maximum of 5 Tents and 5 Ground Blinds. We want to encourage our most avid hunters, after all! While we’re doing this work, we’re also looking into reported issues including Tents and Ground Blinds sometimes disappear from the inventory and storage after dismantling them.

We hope you’ll enjoy these fixes and tweaks. Please let us know what you think in the comments below the announcement or in the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/1333474229065398063//]dedicated forum thread[/url]

Lastly today, we know that many of you are requesting general bug fixes and improvements, and that work is indeed ongoing. We’ll share more about upcoming patches and their content as we finalize them.

Happy hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Support Team[/i]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - A Note about DLC
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/aed7f87c01084b7c7750c2d36a91f729b5e888a1.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Last week, we released the Tents and Ground Blinds DLC. Your reactions to this content have been strong, and they have not fallen on deaf ears. With this note, we hope to clarify our position on DLC in general, and make sure you know what to expect from theHunter: Call of the Wild in the future.

Ever since we announced theHunter: Call of the Wild in late 2016, we were open about the business model we had chosen for the game. We called it a one-time purchase which would be supported by “both free and paid DLC”.

True to that statement, theHunter: Call of the Wild was released as a stand-alone game at $29.99. Since launch, we have released over a dozen patches (typically at least one each week), as well as two minor DLC’s at no cost. The “Tents and Ground Blinds #1” package is our first paid DLC since the February release.

Many have purchased and enjoyed the DLC, but some of you have also expressed criticism and argued that it’s a microtransaction, or that it opens the door for future microtransactions.

To us, there is a rather clear distinction between microtransactions and DLC. For example, if you would have been prompted to repeatedly purchase ammunition, tents or supplies with real-life or premium currency, that would be a clear case of microtransactions. This first paid DLC, on the other hand, is an optional one-time purchase. You certainly don’t need it to enjoy the game. Once you unlock it, you can use it in-game as you please with no need to ever pay for it again. There is no per-item charge in real-life currency, which is a point we probably could have communicated more clearly.

The basic functionality of fast travel and ground blinds already exists in the game. While Tents and Ground Blinds do add to the overall experience, they do not give DLC owners any major edge in the game. Their guests can also use it in multiplayer games. For these reasons, we think of the DLC as optional in every sense.

Some of you have made the point that Tents and Ground Blinds is a smaller addition to the game, and that you would prefer bigger features or brand new hunting reserves as DLC’s. Rest assured that we have heard you, and that our next few DLCs will be more substantial. In the future, we plan to release content of varying character, price (we still have several free DLC’s planned!) and complexity to theHunter: Call of the Wild. Your feedback has made it clear that we should focus on larger or more substantial DLC, rather than smaller stand-alone items, even if those items are one-time purchases and not consumables. We have some very cool content planned, and we can’t wait to share it with you all.

Lastly, let’s talk about bugs. We’ll readily admit that there were too many of those for anyone’s taste at launch. Our dedicated team have since worked tirelessly to squash them, patch by patch, while also adding or tweaking content. We’re happy with how far we've come in the few months since release. However, we are far from done, and future DLC releases will not affect this work in any way. We have a separate team dedicated to fixing bugs, and they will keep working to make the ultimate hunting experience even more enjoyable, regardless if players have all the DLC packages or none of them installed. Speaking of which, Patch 1.7 is being prepared right now.

To round off, we hope that this note provided some clarity behind our reasoning. While it’s never enjoyable to be on the receiving end of criticism, we’re honestly happy to see that you care so deeply about the game. theHunter is a franchise built around - even alongside - its community. theHunter: Call of the Wild will be no exception. We’re still at the very start of this journey. While some of you are also part of the theHunter Classic community, many are new to the franchise. We’re still learning what you value and how you prefer your hunting experience. Rest assured that we listen closely to your feedback, and will do everything we can to advance the game in the direction you hope for.

Thanks for your dedication, and happy hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/aed7f87c01084b7c7750c2d36a91f729b5e888a1.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Last week, we released the Tents and Ground Blinds DLC. Your reactions to this content have been strong, and they have not fallen on deaf ears. With this note, we hope to clarify our position on DLC in general, and make sure you know what to expect from theHunter: Call of the Wild in the future.

Ever since we announced theHunter: Call of the Wild in late 2016, we were open about the business model we had chosen for the game. We called it a one-time purchase which would be supported by “both free and paid DLC”.

True to that statement, theHunter: Call of the Wild was released as a stand-alone game at $29.99. Since launch, we have released over a dozen patches (typically at least one each week), as well as two minor DLC’s at no cost. The “Tents and Ground Blinds #1” package is our first paid DLC since the February release.

Many have purchased and enjoyed the DLC, but some of you have also expressed criticism and argued that it’s a microtransaction, or that it opens the door for future microtransactions.

To us, there is a rather clear distinction between microtransactions and DLC. For example, if you would have been prompted to repeatedly purchase ammunition, tents or supplies with real-life or premium currency, that would be a clear case of microtransactions. This first paid DLC, on the other hand, is an optional one-time purchase. You certainly don’t need it to enjoy the game. Once you unlock it, you can use it in-game as you please with no need to ever pay for it again. There is no per-item charge in real-life currency, which is a point we probably could have communicated more clearly.

The basic functionality of fast travel and ground blinds already exists in the game. While Tents and Ground Blinds do add to the overall experience, they do not give DLC owners any major edge in the game. Their guests can also use it in multiplayer games. For these reasons, we think of the DLC as optional in every sense.

Some of you have made the point that Tents and Ground Blinds is a smaller addition to the game, and that you would prefer bigger features or brand new hunting reserves as DLC’s. Rest assured that we have heard you, and that our next few DLCs will be more substantial. In the future, we plan to release content of varying character, price (we still have several free DLC’s planned!) and complexity to theHunter: Call of the Wild. Your feedback has made it clear that we should focus on larger or more substantial DLC, rather than smaller stand-alone items, even if those items are one-time purchases and not consumables. We have some very cool content planned, and we can’t wait to share it with you all.

Lastly, let’s talk about bugs. We’ll readily admit that there were too many of those for anyone’s taste at launch. Our dedicated team have since worked tirelessly to squash them, patch by patch, while also adding or tweaking content. We’re happy with how far we've come in the few months since release. However, we are far from done, and future DLC releases will not affect this work in any way. We have a separate team dedicated to fixing bugs, and they will keep working to make the ultimate hunting experience even more enjoyable, regardless if players have all the DLC packages or none of them installed. Speaking of which, Patch 1.7 is being prepared right now.

To round off, we hope that this note provided some clarity behind our reasoning. While it’s never enjoyable to be on the receiving end of criticism, we’re honestly happy to see that you care so deeply about the game. theHunter is a franchise built around - even alongside - its community. theHunter: Call of the Wild will be no exception. We’re still at the very start of this journey. While some of you are also part of the theHunter Classic community, many are new to the franchise. We’re still learning what you value and how you prefer your hunting experience. Rest assured that we listen closely to your feedback, and will do everything we can to advance the game in the direction you hope for.

Thanks for your dedication, and happy hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Tents and Ground Blinds DLC
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/92482c54bad179455c7403b752a7a0eaade256bf.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

I'm sure we can all relate to the pain of having discovered diverse and well populated hunting grounds, only to find that they are far away from the next outpost? Until now that meant long hikes through the forests and meadows of the reserves to get to your destination. Luckily, Robert Sommer has very good connections and hence the reserve wardens Conny and Doc were able to reserve a shipment of tents and ground blinds for us. These helpful new gadgets will change the rules of hunting as you know them and are available in different color variations.

Some of you may already know tents and ground blinds from your hunting adventures in theHunter Classic where they are highly useful items for efficient hunting trips, either alone or together with friends in multiplayer. Fast travelling, resting and re-stocking your supplies at your own or at a friend's tent can be crucial factors on extended hunting trips. Combine that with the possibility of setting up a ground blind for you and a friend, calling in your prey from a distance while remaining in perfect camouflage makes for a whole new game dynamic when it comes to hunting in theHunter: Call of the Wild. 
 
You can read all about it on our store page [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/622450/the_Hunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Tents__Ground_Blinds/]store page[/url] where you also will be able to buy the third DLC for theHunter: Call of the Wild as a one-time purchase. 

We hope you’re as excited about it as we are. Make sure to let us know how you like it in the comment section below, or in the dedicated feedback thread by posting your experiences and pictures. We’re looking forward to seeing them!  

Happy Hunting,

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/622450/the_Hunter_Call_of_the_Wild__Tents__Ground_Blinds

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.6
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/7ac5724135684c01be4a4157cb647cfe2aeaac55.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

We hope you’ve had a great Easter weekend with your family and friends. Hopefully you had time for some gaming as well. And as a belated Easter gift - here is Patch 1.6!

This week we've got some exciting fixes and new DLC in store for you (see separate post regarding the latter). As we mentioned in Patch 1.5, we pushed the 'Exit to main menu' button out a bit due to other fixes taking priority, but we're happy to announce that the option is now available in the game menu.

In previous patches we’ve put a strong focus on the stability and overall performance optimization of the game, and we will continue to do so. With great help from our community, we have tracked down and fixed an issue that would cause the scope zeroing of the .338 and 7mm rifles to be inaccurate when fired in crouched position. 

Another issue we noticed is that the 'Death on spawn' bug was not fixed for all players after Patch 1.5 was released, as we continued to receive reports of it happening. This update should ensure that ‘Death on spawn’ is now part of history.

You can read the full list of fixes below - we look forward to reading your feedback and comments regarding the patch in the comment section and the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/133262848299662535/]dedicated feedback thread[/url]. 

Happy Hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added “Exit to main menu” button 
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for a bug that lead to player characters death when spawning into the game.
[*]Fix for an issue that would cause .338 and 7mm rifles to not have a barrel opening to the bullet chamber 
[*]Fix for an issue with Cacciatore 12G that would cause momentary clipping when used with scopes
[*]Fix for an issue with the gamekeeper shotgun that would cause it’s rail to not correctly follow when reloading
[*]Fix for an issue with the huntermate in prone position that could cause it to momentarily “spin”
[*]Fix for a bug where aiming with a scope while crouched was inaccurate for the .338, 7mm and shotguns.
[*]Footprint clues will now properly show the approximate animal weight
[/list]
[h1]Stability fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for crash occurs when changing between windowed and full screen mode, or when alt-tabbing in and out of the game.
[*]Fix for crash if you enter deep water
[*]Fix for crash when starting a game after animal map content has changed
[*]Fix for crash when leaving a dead animal on the ground and traveling far away from it
[*]Fix for crash when bagging an animal in a multiplayer game
[/list]

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/cace02702f64c0bae7d7977c587b42ee8cf4586f.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

We’re excited to release patch 1.5 today! In this update we will be addressing a number of issues such as the animal path finding maps, animals freezing and the ‘death on login’ bug a number of players were experiencing.

The consecutive harvest bonus now carries over in single player games and we aim for the same in multiplayer, but it will require some more work before being released. 

Our focus on improving stability continues with additional crash fixes as well as graphics optimizations that include changes to in-game graphics such as shadows and shaders.

We are aware that some of you are really keen on having the ‘Exit to main menu’ button in-game but we’ve decided to prioritize game stability and bug fixing for now. However, since it’s been discussed in the forum, we wanted to let you know that it is indeed not forgotten, and we plan on including this into the game as soon as it is finalized. 

Also, a special thank you goes out to player ‘Valkenswaard’ who has set up and maintains the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/5/133258092257803156/]bug report thread[/url] on the Steam board. This is a valuable source of information for our developers and we check it on a daily basis.

Finally, we have listed the changes and improvements we made in Patch 1.5 in the sections below. Let us know what you think about it in the comments for the announcement and the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/133261370016620678/]discussions thread[/url] in the forum - we're looking forward to your feedback.

Happy Hunting,

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[h1]Gameplay:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved animal path finding maps. This change will decrease the risk of animals freezing / not moving.
This change will potentially remove some of your discovered need zones.
[*]Fixed point of interest being too close to a rock which killed players 
[*]You will no longer see your own discovered need zones when joining another player’s game.
[*]Fix for player death when starting the game
[*]Spotted animals now count correctly in the “Spot 5 Animals” competition 
[*]Consecutive harvest bonus now carries over in single player games
[/list]

[h1]User Interface:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Localization improvements including fixing cut offs, truncations and more
[*]Waypoint is now consistently orange on the map and mini map and has the correct icon
[/list]

[h1]Audio:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Callers now play in the correct distance when used by other players in multiplayer
[*]Audio settings are now saved correctly
[/list]

[h1]Stability & Performance:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed memory leak in loading screen that could cause a crash.
[*]Fixed issue with grass not showing on long distances when switching between Ultra and Low graphics settings
[*]Performance Improvements:
[*]Fixed issue overwriting scale of horizon and time for shaders
[*]Removed unnecessary functions for shaders
[*]Added culling for tree and vegetation shadows
[*]Fixed mismatching cloud shadows
[*]Optimized cloud particle effects
[*]Optimized performance of vegetation shadows
[*]Improved performance in scope view
[*]Fixed volume fog when shadows are present
[*]Minimized pixel jittering
[*]Fixed mismatching shaders for shadows
[*]Fix for flickering birds
[*]Improved transmissions on trees
[*]Optimized shader complexity for visual results
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed structures that were placed in vegetation 
[*]Fixed various floating assets
[*]Gamepad vibration is now saved correctly
[/list]

Hello Hunters,

In this patch, we’re addressing additional improvements for stability and user interface.

The issue of “ghost” clicks, which would alter menu settings (even after closing them), has now been resolved. Thank you for reporting the issue and helping us find a solution.
The multiplayer menu has received a small update as we have added a confirmation message before starting competitions or kicking other players from your multiplayer game. We have also fixed a number of crashes.

Rest assured that bug fixes and content releases will keep coming. They will not be impacted by the recently announced console version as this is handled by separate teams within the company. To keep improving the stability, polish and overall experience of this version is - and will continue to be - our dedicated PC team's highest priority.

Thank you all for your continued support and for sharing constructive feedback with us, we really appreciate it! As always, you can find the list of fixes below to get the full overview

Happy Hunting,

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team
 

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]

[b]User Interface:[/b]

[*]Reworked layout of the Multiplayer menu

[*]Fix for crash after confirming the harvest screen

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/867eed0c0f5f7cdadaa1c8ae6690ddaa6ef878b8.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Patch 1.4 is out now, so let’s have a look at some of the highlights.

[u]Gameplay[/u]
We started to address issues with animals being stuck and frozen. This is the first iteration and we will continue to improve this part of the game.
Additionally, a couple of issues have been addressed to make playing the game a smoother experience. Imperial and metric systems have been fixed, so now you can carry the same regardless of system. Aiming with bows will no longer cause scope glitches. You will no longer be hurt when spawning close to other players. Weapon and item sounds no longer vanish after switching items multiple times. Lastly on the gameplay side of things, shotgun score awards as well as incorrect magazine size have been fixed.

[u]User Interface[/u]
The mirrored custom waypoint is no more, truncated and cut off localization texts have been improved and the tracking cone on the minimap now correctly scales based on your skill.

[u]Stability[/u]
We introduced the first changes to address “freezing” issues. This issue remains our highest priority, and we will continue to work on it. 
A host of different crashes have been fixed as well and we will continue to monitor stability after the patch. The multitude of different hard- and software set ups is always a challenge, but we are committed to continuously improve stability.

As always, you can find the list of fixes below to get the full overview and we are looking forward to your feedback.

Happy Hunting,

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team


[h1]Fixes:[/h1]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[*]Fixed issue for shotgun score being awarded instead of rifle score for the 30-30 Lever Action Rifle
[*]Fixes to address stuck and “frozen” animals
[*]Reworked fall damage and physics, eliminating death by rocks and bushes.
[*]Corrected .270 Warden magazine size from 5 to 4
[*]Weapon statistics tweaked to better reflect how they perform in the game
[*]Sommer - Mr. Sommers Bow & Vualez #8 can now be completed with Bearclaw Lite CB-60
[*]Imperial and metric systems now use the same item capacity
[*]Aiming with the bow will no longer cause other scopes to have incorrect offset
[*]Players will no longer be hurt or killed when spawning too close to each other
[*]Holding breath with bows now correctly increases heart rate and decreases wobble
[*]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck at maximum wobble when aiming

[b]User Interface:[/b]
[*]Fixed mirrored custom waypoint
[*]Added game version in Main Menu
[*]Improved and added localization
[*]Improved tracking cone on minimap based on tracking skill
[*]Improved clearing of player icons on map


[b]Stability & Performance:[/b]
[*]Crash fix related to mini map
[*]Fixed crash when changing reserve
[*]Crash fix related to player icons on the map
[*]Fixed crashes related to mismatching clues
[*]Additional crash fixes
[*]Improved error handling in case of graphics device failing. Players will now receive a message which is likely due to GPU being below minimal specifications
[*]Fixed disappearing clues in multiplayer
[*]Performance improvements when using binoculars on low graphical settings

[b]Audio:[/b]
[*]Weapon and item sounds now work correctly after switching items multiple times

[b]Terrain:[/b]
[*]Terrain updates to remove tunnels
[*]Various fixes for floating items

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Call of the Week
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/fd71c859fea8968195aeefe88a0c6144e02a2f4e.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

It’s once again Friday and we hope you’re all looking forward to a hunting filled weekend! Since Stefan is currently on vacation, Marketing Coordinator Johanna has taken over the task of delivering this Call of the Week. 

[b]Patch 1.3[/b]
It’s been a busy week for the developers with Patch 1.3 released on Tuesday. The patch contained a bunch of bug fixes and improvements, and we also implemented a new feature for Skills & Perks Re-specialisation that will allow you to reset your skill points in order to maximize your points. You can get the full list of fixes and more information about the feature [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/518790/announcements/detail/521695323701996259]here[/url].

[b]DLC - Bearclaw Lite CB-60 Compound Bow[/b]
Yesterday we released our first DLC for the game - The The Bearclaw Lite CB-60 Compound Bow. We want to show our appreciation to all of you for supporting us throughout the first month of theHunter: Call of the Wild through this free DLC. Just head over to the store page [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/602310/]here[/url] for the free download. It will then be available to unlock in the in-game store. Enjoy!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/78a02662d367d88957d4d678fe0d914cb4057c28.png[/img]

[b]Video Competition - Getting Started[/b]
Today we’re launching our first video competition. To take part you need to create a video focusing on how to get started in the game. We’re also giving away some exclusive prizes to the top three winners, so make sure to check out the details [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/518790/announcements/detail/521695432459009870]here[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/aca81eed0076dcf94474bfcd5314e8956e581df7.png[/img]

We will of course continue to work hard on investigating bugs, crashes and other issues with the game that you guys have reported. If you would like to help us make our work easier, please check out the bug report forum [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/5/]here[/url].

That’s all for this week! Have a great weekend and make sure to take care out in the wild! :)

Happy hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]


Find us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/theHunterCOTW
Fins us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thehuntercotw/

notes.title: The Bearclaw Lite CB-60 Compound Bow
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/78a02662d367d88957d4d678fe0d914cb4057c28.png[/img]

[h1]The Bearclaw Lite CB-60 Compound Bow[/h1]

Today, theHunter: Call of the Wild celebrates its first month! As a way of thanking everyone for your support during this time, we have decided to release a first free DLC that includes the Bearclaw Lite CB-60 Compound Bow that you can purchase for earned currency in the in-game store.

[i]What’s great about bows?[/i]
Bows are generally harder to master than rifles, but an adept bow hunter is a lot stealthier. Shooting a bow will naturally spook less animals in your surroundings than shooting a rifle, which can be a serious advantage in a densely populated area. 

[i]What’s great about the Bearclaw Lite CB-60 Compound Bow?[/i]
A compound bow uses mechanics that makes it easier to draw and hold for longer periods of time compared to a traditional bow. This tends to allow for greater accuracy.

Make sure to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/602310/]download your free DLC here![/url]


[h1]Skills & Perks Re-specialization[/h1]

Have you spent a skill point but then thought it might have been better used elsewhere, only to realize you can’t change it? Well this is no longer an issue thanks to the skills and perks re-specialization (which is not part of the DLC, but part of this week's patch). 

In the skills and perks menu you can now reset your spent skills and perk points to better customize your character. 

Choosing the right skills and perks is vital and essential for every hunter and the choices you make have a significant impact on gameplay, so there will be an in-game cost attached to resetting your points. Note that the more skill or perk points you want to reset, the higher the cost.

We hope you like this new feature as well as the new compound bow, and look forward to getting your feedback on the update and DLC. Please let us know what you think in the comments below or in the DLC reviews!

Also, we are analyzing great findings from yesterday’s patch and continue our work for the next one. Stay tuned for more.

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/0b3eb20c186d0a75c8772255fd09d34aec29d383.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Patch 1.3 has just been released, so let’s have a look at what’s inside.

[u]Skills & Perks Re-specialisation[/u]
You can now reset your spent skills and perk points to better customize your character. Choosing the right skills and perks is vital for every hunter, so there is a cost attached to resetting your points. We hope you like the addition of this feature and are looking forward to your feedback.

[u]Exit to Main Menu[/u]
Our intention was to bring an “Exit to Main Menu” option to the game with today’s patch but it is unfortunately not ready yet. We are aware that this feature is requested, we just need a bit more time to guarantee that it works flawlessly.

[u]Freezes, Clues and Stability[/u]
We optimized the clue system to improve performance, as well as eliminate disappearing clues and crashes. Work will continue in this area, so please let us know your feedback regarding the new version.

Better data collection has been added in case of freezes which will help us to get the information we need. Freezes will most likely result in crashes now, and that information will be sent to us so we can work on fixing them permanently.

Screen space reflections are now enabled by default for “medium” and “low” graphics settings. This should help players who have trouble starting the game. You can still disable this option in the graphics settings for better performance (it affects water reflections).

Ammunition has undergone another round of tweaking and costs have been decreased.

As always, you can find the list of fixes below to get the full overview. We’ll continue our work and talk to you soon again! 

Happy Hunting,

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added re-specialisation of Skills and Perks
[*]Clues now correctly despawn after fast traveling
[*]Corrected expansion and penetration stats for soft point and polymeric tip rifle ammunition
[*]Fix for “Connor - Lost Words” if you find the notebook before finishing the first objective
[*]Reduced cost of ammunition
[/list]

[b]User Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed interactions with Hunting Stands
[*]Various localisation fixes
[/list]

[b]Stability & Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enabled screen space reflections (water reflections) by default on medium and low graphics settings
[*]Improved data collection on deadlocks (freezes)
[*]Mini map performance optimization
[*]Various crash fixes
[/list]

[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved synchronization of all weapon reload animations
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added credits
[/list]

notes.title: THEHUNTER:COTW - Call of the week
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/e2612c240d58673e50143fbb7ad0c34a5ea517e5.png[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Here’s a quick update on the status of the next patch, as well as some features and fixes that we are currently working on. You may have asked yourselves “where is this week’s patch?”. In order to make sure that the changes we will introduce in Patch 1.3 works smoothly we’ve decided to do some additional testing, hence the delay. Our current plan is to release Patch 1.3 during next week.

So, what’s coming up? 

[list]
[*]A ‘Return to main menu’ button will be added in order to prevent players from having to restart the game every time.
[*]There will be optimizations and fixes for animal tracks disappearing and wearing down performance.
[*]To get a better understanding of the freezing issues (which results in a deadlock where players have to stop the process of the game via task manager) there will be additional monitoring introduced that will aid in fixing the issue for good.
[*]Ammunition costs have undergone another round of balancing. 
Issues when starting the game due to screen reflections will be addressed.
[*]Animal pathfinding is currently being investigated but will not be released in the next patch, however more specific information about it will be posted in the patch notes next week. You can find a sticky thread on Steam where we are gathering detailed information regarding the issue. http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/5/133259227513211141/
[/list]

Also, don’t forget to check-out our Twitch Live Stream on Tuesday March 14 at 4PM CET - we might show-off something that you haven’t seen before...

https://www.twitch.tv/expansiveworlds

That’s it from us for today. We wish you all a fantastic weekend and perhaps we’ll see you in a theHunter: Call of the Wild multiplayer session during the weekend?! 

Happy Hunting,

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

Find us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/theHunterCOTW

Hello Hunters,

It’s our second week post-launch and it’s time for Patch 1.2.

While continuously working on bug fixes, crashes and performance improvements, we also track all the great feedback that you keep providing, which is of big help to us! We look forward to hearing your thoughts regarding the latest changes we have made - for example the slower stalking speed while crouching (with keyboard controls).

In addition we want to thank you for the consistent and fantastic support you give each other in our Steam forums. Be sure to visit there for ‘unofficial’ community fixes and work around solutions until official patches come along.

One thread we wanted to highlight was started by community member “Sento” as he couldn’t start the game and player "Slackard" provided a suggestion that might help other players, too. You can find Slackard’s suggestion on top in our technical troubleshooting sticky post:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/4/133258092236941314/

Finally, we just wanted to give a general piece of advice to keep your graphic drivers up to date. Crash reports on our end indicate that there are some outdated drivers out there so make sure to check that you have the latest version running on your machine.

Nvidia: http://www.geforce.com/geforce-experience/download
AMD: http://support.amd.com/en-us/download

We hope you enjoy Patch 1.2 and see you soon for the next update. You can discuss feedback in our dedicated Patch 1.2 thread here: 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/133258593390485033/

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed default speeds for crouch and prone to be slower (use “run” keybind to move faster)
[*]Crouching now correctly affects Animal AI
[*]Balanced difficulty settings for photo missions
[*]Balanced equipment prices in the in-game store
[*]Fixed missions so they can be completed with the .270 Warden rifle
[*]Fixed issue with “Big Coyote Tour” mission
[*]Improved interactions of Points of Interest and Hunting Structures
[*]Fixed distance requirement in Sommers mission “The Fox and the Scope” to 200 meters
[*]Improved Sommer #2

[*]Specified the region where to find the coyote in Vualez “The Werecoyote”
[/list]

[b]User Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved feedback for noise in HUD
[*]Various fixes for overflows, cutoffs and unlocalized strings
[*]Fixed storage freezing when used
[*]Harvest screen lists hit starting with 1 now
[*]Player placed waypoints can now be seen from any distance
[*]Fix for empty Mission Log when switching reserves
[*]Fixed a bug where droppings would not correctly indicate time since creation and instead always show "just now" when investigated
[/list]

[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added female breathing and damage sounds for player character
[*]Added sound for Headlamp when turning it on / off
[*]Improvement of UI Mix
[*]Improvement of Music Mix
[*]Improvement of Bear mix
[*]Added Jump sounds for main character
[*]Changed rabbits/squirrel navigation sounds
[*]Improve animal vegetation passthrough sounds 
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed spawn point outside of reserve
[*]Various fixes for floating props in the world
[*]Fixed issue with proning and looking through the terrain
[/list]

[b]In Progress[/b]
Nearing completion, to be released soon:
[list]
[*]Adding Exit to Main Menu
[*]Crashfix when starting the game
[*]Performance improvements after having scanned multiple clues

notes.notes:

We are working on a hotfix for Progression to unlock requirements when you exceed them as well as a crash for specific languages when bringing up the scoreboard in multiplayer.
The solutions are being tested now but we can't give a release time yet.
For locked items, try gaining experience and restarting the game until the hotfix is out.
----

Hello Hunters,

We are happy to announce the release of Patch 1.1 for theHunter: Call of the Wild, which offers a number of fixes for gameplay, performance and multiplayer. Your continuous feedback and detailed reports have helped the dev team and Producer Phil with prioritizing and fixing some of the most pressing issues.

While I write this our dev team have already started their work on Patch 1.2 which will address further issues reported via social media, the Steam forums and customer service. We want to take this chance to thank you for your ongoing support and also assure you that we will continue to work hard on solving issues and making theHunter: Call of the Wild an even better hunting experience for all of our players.

We look forward to hearing from you regarding Patch 1.1 in our dedicated feedback thread: 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/0/133258092236333090/

Happy Hunting!

[i]theHunter: Call of the Wild Team[/i] 

[h1]Major fixes:[/h1] 

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added cool-down timer to animal warning calls
[*]Animal warning call probability is now affected by animal difficulty
[*]Adjusted how easily animals can hear you when walking through grass and bushes in Layton Lake District
[*]Adjusted vegetation sound volumes in Layton Lake District
[*]Reworked player progression - less cost and faster unlocks
[*]Resolved issue with side mission Sommer #2 
[/list]

[b]User Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for hunting stands that can’t be interacted with
[/list]

[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved performance after tracking a large number of clues
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for multiplayer crashes related to Multiplayer menu
[/list]

[h1]Minor fixes:[/h1]

[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for menu music not playing
[*]Improved sound mix for UI
[*]Improved sound mix for Black Bear
[*]Improved sound mix for music in outposts
[*]Added jumping sounds for player character
[/list]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved animal spawn points to avoid tight positions for pathfinding
[*]Fix for "Active Skill" tutorial would not play until restarting the game
[*]Heart rate is now affected when jumping
[*]Improved clue system for need zones
[*]Added glint effect on collectables
[*]Improvements to navigation mesh
[*]Fix for female foxes awarding negative score
[*]Fix for non-climbable ladders
[*]Fix for HunterMate showing missions from the previously visited reserve
[/list]

[b]Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for revolver exit animation
[*]Fix for occasionally misaligned muzzle flash when using quickshot
[*]Improved scope behaviour while aiming and walking
[*]Improved Lever Action Rifle animations
[*]Improved shotgun reload animation (displaying wrong bullet count)
[*]Improved animations for compound bow
[*]Fixed so that performing an action will never lock the player into place (firing, [*]aiming, reloading etc.)
[*]Tweaked scatter for hipshot and fixed some issues with scatter in aim
[/list]

[b]User Interface:[/b]

[list]
[*]Removed leaving reserve warning message after loading reserve
[*]Fixed bug where attaching ammo would hide item details
[*]Improving readability of codex pages, slow down scrolling text
[*]Added game logo to main menu
[*]Improved Key binding UI and fixed issue with double clicking
[*]Removed “Reserve Selection” text
[*]Added camera as bindable key
[*]Added “Use Skill” as bindable key
[*]Added numpad as bindable keys
[*]Fix for audio clue HUD never being shown again after having it visible and entering the menu
[*]Changing the “buy” button in the store to “owned” after purchase
[*]Inventory updates quicker after making changes in the storage
[*]Improved display of available amount of currency
[*]Added warning prompt when starting a new game
[*]Re-enabled HUD when using the camera
[*]Fix for weapon rewards not showing
[*]Improved Storage screen usability
[*]Fixed “night time” in codex vs. mission conditions (night time starts at 19:00)
[*]Artifacts are now added to the Codex page when picked up
[*]Mouse sensitivity now works as intended
[*]Toggling “Mission System” in settings now works as intended
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for network collectables competing with regular collectables
[*]Disabled changing reserve in Multiplayer
[/list]

[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*]Addressed memory leaks
[*]Slightly improved performance of water reflections
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous:[/h1] 

[list]
[*]Fix for appearing underwater when changing position (loading screen)
[*]Multiple fixes regarding spawn point and camera sequences
[*]Fix for critter related crash
[*]Collision fixes in Layton Lake District
[*]Missing shaders added
[*]Various mission fixes
[*]Crashfix when switching reserve
[*]Various fixes for floating props
[*]Crashfix when switching between single and multiplayer games
[*]Improved string jump animations of animals
[*]Removed breathing animation on dead animals 
[*]Various localization fixes
[*]Improved water reflections
[*]Fixed broken glint effect while it’s raining
[*]Rain drops are now properly occluded by structures
[*]Added particle effects while walking through foliage
[*]Fix for animals running in place in certain animations
[*]Fixed bug in volumetric fog that would cause it to be wrongly occluded by vegetation
[/list]

I wanted to give you an quick update on the current state of the game and upcoming improvements and plans for fixes. The development team, lead by our Producer Philipp, are hard at work on addressing the issues reported by you.

prioritize our work - we could not do it without you.  

We look forward to sharing more on Patch 1.1, as well as general progress, soon.

Happy Hunting!

Stefan

notes.title: THEHUNTER: COTW - Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

Here is another update from our side as we address the issues that you mention and report.

Once more we want to say thank you for your support, reporting these issues to us and of course for playing theHunter: Call of the Wild. It’s great to see the wonderful screenshots, videos and achievements from the community and we are working on solutions to improve the game and performance for our players.

Next to the smaller updates from today and yesterday, there is a bigger patch on its way. We can’t give you a final release date yet as testing is still in progress but we plan to release it very soon.

[b]Today’s update includes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Fix for “Invite to game” feature on Steam that would ultimately lead to a crash
[*]Crash fix for hovering over specific icons in the map
[*]Crash fix for ragdoll synchronization for spawned animals
[*]Disabled joining friends in multiplayer games when the game is not running
[*]Miscellaneous crash fixes
[/list]

Additionally, there is a partial fix for joining friends in multiplayer. As long as the game is running, you will be able to join a friend’s game via the Steam functionality. Please make sure your friends have the game running when sending invites to play via Steam.

If you don’t have the game running and join a game after the update, you will only start the game.

We are also working together with AMD to investigate and fix any hardware related issues that were reported by our players.

And finally, there are work-around solutions to some problems until we can fix them for good:

[b]Keybindings[/b]

You can manually adjust your keybindings outside of the game by doing the following:

[list]
[*]Disable cloud saving on Steam (Properties -> Updates -> Untick Steam Cloud Synchronization)
[*]Go to Documents\Avalanche Studios\theHunter Call of the Wild\Saves open your save folder
[*]Open “keymap.json” with a text editor of your choice (e.g. Notepad)
[*]Manually adjust keybindings
[*]Save file and start the game (keeping cloud save disabled until you have started it once)
[/list]

[b]Return to Game from Settings menu[/b]
[list]
[*]Hovering over any of the main menu icons on the left side of the screen and then pressing ESC will return you to the game.
[/list]

Thanks again and happy hunting!

Stefan

[*]Fix for “Invite to game” feature on Steam that would ultimately lead to a crash
[*]Crash fix for hovering over specific icons in the map
[*]Crash fix for ragdoll synchronization for spawned animals
[*]Disabled joining friends in multiplayer games when the game is not running
[*]Miscellaneous crash fixes
[/list]

Additionally, there is a partial fix for joining friends in multiplayer. As long as the game is running, you will be able to join a friend’s game via the Steam functionality. Please make sure your friends have the game running when sending invites to play via Steam.

If you don’t have the game running and join a game after the update, you will only start the game.

We are also working together with AMD to investigate and fix any hardware related issues that were reported by our players.

And finally, there are work-around solutions to some problems until we can fix them for good:

[b]Keybindings[/b]

You can manually adjust your keybindings outside of the game by doing the following:

[list]
[*]Disable cloud saving on Steam (Properties -> Updates -> Untick Steam Cloud Synchronization)
[*]Go to Documents\Avalanche Studios\theHunter Call of the Wild\Saves open your save folder
[*]Open “keymap.json” with a text editor of your choice (e.g. Notepad)
[*]Manually adjust keybindings
[*]Save file and start the game (keeping cloud save disabled until you have started it once)
[/list]

[b]Return to Game from Settings menu[/b]
[list]
[*]Hovering over any of the main menu icons on the left side of the screen and then pressing ESC will return you to the game.
[/list]

Thanks again and happy hunting!

Stefan

notes.title: The species of Hirschfelden and Layton Lake District
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters,

We have talked a lot about the diverse environments of Hirschfelden and Layton Lake District over the past days. But of course we know that you are all very curious about the huntable species in theHunter: Call of the Wild. We have created this gallery to introduce the species that you can meet in the world and hope you find it interesting.

[b]Red Deer[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/f795e841fed305ef7c899716b490c0e6b6ed2561.jpg[/img]
 
One of the largest deer species native to Europe, Western Asia and Northern Africa, the red deer is also related to the American elk. They usually can be found in forest areas where they live in groups and are easily identifiable by their large antlers and red-brown fur pattern.

[b]Fallow Deer[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/f05f37cd3c6554013e75e811b2354f8c257e20fe.jpg[/img]

Native to western Europe, the fallow deer with its distinctive palmated antlers and pale brown colored fur can be seen in a variety of woodland areas and open fields. These herbivores can sometimes reach a weight of up to 100 kilograms (220 lbs) for males and 50 kilograms (110 lbs) for females 

[b]Roe Deer[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/eae150c7959038c85ae3fb84cdea1051ef9bdbc0.jpg[/img]

The roe deer is native to the continent of Europe and can mostly be spotted in forest areas, from which it sometimes strays to feed on grassland or cultivated soil such as fields. It can be identified by its very distinct call, resembling a barking sound, as well as its relatively small size and unique fur color.

[b]Red Fox[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/fcf38518e5284a0b16570ee9b8bfcc1c1826774d.jpg[/img]

The red fox can be met in the entire northern hemisphere and belongs to the larger fox species. It can be easily identified by its characteristic orange-red fur as well as thick and furry tail. Being relatively small, as well as a master of stealth in its territory, it can prove a challenge when hunting them.

[b]Wild Boar[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/54a14a3742e8679d0758d18cf4951f6eab57c477.jpg[/img]

The wild boar is one of the most widely spread and highly adaptable mammals that can be found in the majority of areas in Europe and Asia. Despite being rather small and bulky, it can still reach an impressive speed of up to 40 km/h (25 mph) when startled. The wild boar is  a social animal living in family herds where the mother will most often be at the top of the hierarchy. Adult males can often be found roaming alone, but are known to temporarily join a herd during mating season.   

[b]European Bison[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/ba4364e4c1d1be18f28c4586b25e08853baf4a06.jpg[/img]

One of the biggest and heaviest animals native to the central European fauna, the European wood bison was nearly hunted to extinction in the early 20th century. Reaching a weight up to nearly a metric ton (2200 lbs) it can be found in forest areas and is known to defend itself fiercely if provoked or attacked.

[b]Whitetail Deer[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/5891593becb003038d9b504d179587cfb7fb28f0.jpg[/img]

The whitetail deer is known to be one of the fastest moving deer species, able to reach incredible speeds of up to 75 km/h (47 mph) when startled and fleeing. haracterized mostly by its white tail and the shape of its antlers, the white tail deer can be found in various environments,from forests to prairie.   

[b]Moose[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/eecf0099ae72be5cf9e8f149fe5ab33932e17994.jpg[/img]

Unlike a lot of species in the deer family, the Moose is a rather solitary animal, roaming forest and grassland areas of the northern hemisphere. It can be easily identified by its large palmated antlers, long legs and big snout. Also unlike  most other deer species, its behaviour can become aggressive and the Moose is  known to attack when startled or threatened. 

[b]Roosevelt Elk[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/a0ec52cf02426b0d7786d8dd1a14f22c31ae718e.jpg[/img]

The Roosevelt elk, with its characteristically large, spiky antlers, can be found in a variety of different terrains such as forest areas,steep or flat grass land, mostly in larger groups. The size difference between male and female animals can be as big as 40%, with an average male weighing up to 330 kilograms (730 lbs)   

[b]Black Bear[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/a79d1f5cc89fb8fa237cda4e4072125f3102af83.jpg[/img]

While being considered relatively small among bears, the black bear is still a very impressive animal, weighing up to 250 kilograms (551 lbs). It can be found in large forest areas and have an outstanding sense of hearing and smell, which makes it challenging to get close to it.

[b]Coyote[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/f444dbc69a1e8e341cf39f4bf1d704733ef160b9.jpg[/img]

The coyotes is mostly spread across Central and North America where it can be found roaming alone or in small packs. It mostly hunts small game such as rabbits or snakes, and  is also highly adaptable to a large diversity of environments, even those shaped by humans.

[b]Blacktail Deer[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/a903a40399326ec66f2200e576a5e853e729c349.jpg[/img]

Considered to be a subspecies of the mule deer, the blacktail deer is native to the west of the North American continent. Avoiding open areas, they are mostly seen around the edges of forests where grass and bushes thrive.


Let us know which species are your favorites in the comments below! 

Cheers,

Stefan

notes.title: Announcing Layton Lake District hunting reserve & Release Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/717134f286a36ec5f0d49c741d9164baac9b33ea.jpg[/img]

Hello Hunters,

Today we have a very special treat for all fans of theHunter: Call of the Wild. We’re excited to announce the reveal of our second major hunting reserve, Layton Lake District, as part of the release version of theHunter: Call of the Wild. Set in the Pacific Northwest, ‘Layton Lake District’ offers a dramatic departure from the mellow autumn hues of the previously announced Hirschfelden hunting reserve. Featuring dense pine forests surrounded by snow-covered peaks; the vast landscape is inhabited by majestic game like the Moose, the Whitetail Deer, the Roosevelt Elk, the Black Bear, and more. 

A total of 14 unique base weapons are available across the two massive reserves, ranging from long-range rifles to stealthy precision bows and agile handguns. Some can be customized with scopes and outfitted with different types of ammunition. A set of skills can also alter the way you handle weapons, like decreasing recoil or reloading faster in a tight spot.

We will be releasing more detailed information on the weapons and animals featured in theHunter: Call of the Wild over the next days, leading up to launch on the 16th of February, so stay tuned.

And now the moment we’ve all been waiting for - We’re proud to present to you the official release trailer of our beautiful reserve ‘Layton Lake District’.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fit-YafCu98&feature=youtu.be

We hope you enjoyed this as much as we did. Let us know what you think in the comments of the video and announcement!

Cheers,

Stefan

notes.title: Join theHunter: Call of the Wild test group [CLOSED]
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/4dcc7f5196c165ebbf314a4ef80af5bb2411d75d.jpg[/img]

We're very excited to announce the creation of 'theHunter Heroes', a small volunteer team of game testers for theHunter: Call of the Wild, and now we are looking for participants like YOU! 

So, what does it mean to take part in ‘theHunter Heroes’ team for theHunter: Call of the Wild? Well, it means you get access to a pre-release version of the game so you can play, hunt and roam the vast forests and fields of Hirschfelden. In return you will provide us with feedback on your game play experience, report potential bugs and test all aspects of the game. All the participants of the group will have a direct line to the dev team and you will be able to give your input on a regular basis and have a chance at affecting how the game grows and develops over time. 

If this sounds interesting and you would like a chance at joining our volunteer game tester team then please fill out our application survey: [Applications closed]

We really hope to hear from you!

- Your theHunter: Call of the Wild Team

EDIT: Thank you all very much for the overwhelming support and response. We have received over 700 applications and will be filtering them over the next days and get in contact with the selected volunteers as soon as possible. The application form has now been closed.

notes.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild starts stalking in February
notes.notes: theHunter: Call of the Wild [official site] sounds almost like a game I’d adore. Pottering through countryside, woods, and wetlands (built in the same shiny engine as Just Cause 3) which teem with wildlife, through day and night, sun and rain, is very much my bag. I’m less keen on the ‘shooting animals’ part. Seems a shame to disrupt an afternoon stroll with bangs and blood, yeah? However, emboldened after reading Brendan’s ridealong with a real hunter through its free-to-play precursor, I think I’ll have a crack at Call of the Wild on its newly-announced release date of February 16th. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Announcing theHunter: Call of the Wild Release Date and Exclusive Items
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/89e9e1d390af06e2d8a84fd5dd706c51cbfed924.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce the release date for theHunter: Call of the Wild! The ultimate hunting experience will be available worldwide on February 16, 2017 for PC via Steam and select retailers.

theHunter: Call of the Wild is the evolution of theHunter Classic, Expansive Worlds’ stand-out hunting game, with over 6 million registered players and 7 years of live operations. As a gesture of appreciation to our incredible community, theHunter Classic players will be able to redeem exclusive items in theHunter: Call of the Wild at no cost.

All theHunter Classic players that have reached a Hunter Score of 50 or more, and/or have purchased a membership at any point, can redeem two exclusive items – the .270 Warden Rifle and the Dry Leaves Ghillie Suit.

Likewise, players of theHunter: Call of the Wild will be awarded a unique weapon in theHunter: Classic, further underlining our commitment to let both games live alongside and complement each other. Both offers are exclusive and time limited. They will be available at launch and expire after the first 90 days post-launch (May 16, 2017) never to be offered again.

Here you can find the portal to check if you are eligible for the exclusive items offer: http://cotwpromo.thehunter.com/#/

[b]theHunter Trailer competition[/b]

Who didn’t dream of being famous at some point? Here’s your chance! Today we’re announcing the comeback of our popular video trailer competition!

[img]http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/SplashScreen_trailercompetition2016.png[/img]

We ran our first [url=http://forum.thehunter.com/viewtopic.php?f=142&t=77919]video trailer competition[/url] almost three years ago and it was a huge success. The engagement and creativity you showed was amazing and you’ve made some real masterpieces. The game has changed dramatically since then, and we are eager to see what you’ll come up with now! We’ve prepared some sweet prizes for you, the main one being a free copy of theHunter: Call of the Wild – oh yes! Now go put your creative caps on, make sure to read the rules carefully in [url=http://forum.thehunter.com/viewtopic.php?f=142&t=77919]this forum thread[/url][url=http://forum.thehunter.com/viewtopic.php?f=142&t=53986] and happy filming![/url]

We are very much looking forward to seeing your Trailers and inspirational ideas that make your own vision of theHunter come alive!

Cheers,

Stefan

Hello Hunters,

A lot has happened during the Beta of "Call of the Wild". Today I want to share with you the long and dangerous journey the hunters Xanton & Dgeesio have taken upon themselves. They have hiked and climbed for hours to make their way all the way up to the peak. Follow them on their individual, snowy adventures!

Xanton´s picture story on Steam: http://steamcommunity.com/app/518790/discussions/1/1842367319515941640/

Dgeesio's video log on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mrEHUCZ1BpQ
Dgeesio's Twitter: https://twitter.com/Dgeesio

If you have funny, interesting or insightful content from the Beta you would like to share make sure to let me know :-D 

Cheers,

Stefan

notes.title: Supported Languages During the Beta
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27000850/80ff9e04b45afd06ace5f19fb5d9146d0aa773da.png[/img]

Hi Hunters, 

It's day - 2 until the Beta and we're really happy to see all the excitement and anticipation. 

We just wanted to inform you that during the Beta, the game will only support English audio and text. We are working really hard with industry leaders on translating all the text in the game, as we want to make sure that we deliver a high-quality localized experience. 

When we launch in early spring, all voice content will be in English and additionally, all written content will be localized to Russian, French, German, and Brazilian-Portuguese.

Continue on sharing your ideas, thoughts and speculations!

theHunter: Call of the Wild Team
